title: E-Commerce Operations VA
description:
### Shopify, Product Sourcing & Social Media  

**Part-Time | 10 Hours Per Week | Potential for Hours & Responsibilities to Grow**



## ABOUT HOUSE OF SPLOOTS



House of Sploots is a new Australian e-commerce brand specialising in **beautiful, practical dog accessories and dog-friendly homewares**.



We are creating a brand for people who adore their dogs but also care about how their homes look.



Our goal is to offer thoughtfully selected products that are comfortable and practical for pets while also being attractive enough to sit naturally alongside the rest of the furniture and décor in a modern home.



House of Sploots is inspired by my dog Nyla, a Staffy/pit bull cross, and by my own experience trying to find dog products that were practical, comfortable and genuinely attractive.



### We are currently PRE-LAUNCH.



The Shopify website is being built and developed now and **has not yet gone live to customers**.



This is an important part of the role because the person joining me will have the opportunity to help properly organise and prepare the store for launch rather than simply maintain an already established website.



I am looking for an **experienced, highly capable and proactive E-Commerce Virtual Assistant** who can work directly with me as the founder.



This is **not a basic data-entry VA position**.



I am looking for someone who understands e-commerce, Shopify, product sourcing and social media and who is comfortable taking genuine ownership of their work.



I do not want to provide step-by-step instructions for every single task.



I want someone who can be given an objective, investigate the best way to achieve it, complete the work carefully, identify problems along the way and communicate clearly about what has been completed.



---



# THE ROLE



The position will initially be approximately:



## 10 HOURS PER WEEK



Your responsibilities will primarily fall into three areas:



### 1. Shopify & E-Commerce Operations  

### 2. Product & Supplier Sourcing  

### 3. Social Media & Content Management



You will work directly with me and help prepare House of Sploots for launch and then assist with the ongoing operation and growth of the business.



---



# 1. SHOPIFY & E-COMMERCE MANAGEMENT



Strong hands-on Shopify experience is essential.



You will help build, organise, check and maintain the House of Sploots Shopify store.



Responsibilities may include:



- Adding new products

- Editing existing products

- Creating professional product titles

- Writing and formatting product descriptions

- Adding product images

- Organising product images

- Optimising images for website use

- Adding product videos where available

- Creating product variants

- Correctly entering pricing

- Managing SKUs

- Updating inventory settings

- Creating collections

- Creating automated collections where appropriate

- Creating product categories and subcategories

- Correctly tagging products

- Managing product types

- Managing vendor information

- Using Shopify metafields where appropriate

- Ensuring products appear in the correct collections

- Creating and updating navigation menus

- Checking store filters

- Checking search functionality

- Maintaining collection pages

- Updating homepage sections

- Updating promotional areas

- Creating and editing website pages

- Maintaining FAQs

- Updating customer information pages

- Adding SEO page titles

- Writing meta descriptions

- Adding image alt text

- Creating SEO-friendly URLs

- Checking internal website links

- Identifying broken links

- Testing desktop presentation

- Testing mobile presentation

- Testing buttons

- Testing menus

- Testing forms

- Checking the customer journey

- Helping install and configure Shopify apps

- Troubleshooting basic Shopify and app issues

- Liaising with app support when required

- Maintaining a clean and organised Shopify backend



A product being uploaded is **not enough**.



Every product needs to be correctly presented, categorised, priced, tagged and connected to the appropriate collections so that the entire online store makes sense to the customer.



---



# SHIPPING & PRODUCT INFORMATION



Accurate shipping and product information is extremely important.



You may be responsible for researching and maintaining information including:



- Supplier shipping costs

- Shipping to Australia

- Dropshipping arrangements

- Supplier processing times

- Estimated delivery times

- Shipping profiles

- Product weights

- Product dimensions

- Shipping restrictions

- Oversized-product shipping requirements

- Regional restrictions

- Tracking availability

- Supplier returns

- Damaged-product procedures

- Replacement procedures

- Customer return implications



You must be comfortable investigating information rather than simply copying whatever a supplier has written.



If something does not make sense, I expect you to investigate it.



If shipping information is contradictory, unclear or missing, I want it identified before the product goes live.



---



# 2. PRODUCT SOURCING



A significant part of the role will involve helping me source products for House of Sploots.



You must have strong online research skills and ideally have previous experience sourcing products for e-commerce businesses.



We will use platforms and suppliers including:



- **Alibaba**

- **Syncee**

- Australian wholesalers

- Australian dropshipping suppliers

- International manufacturers

- International dropshipping suppliers

- Other suitable supplier platforms where appropriate



Experience using **Alibaba and Syncee is highly desirable**.



You should understand the difference between:



- Dropshipping

- Wholesale purchasing

- MOQ purchasing

- Private labelling

- Custom manufacturing

- Supplier fulfilment

- Australian-held stock

- Overseas-held stock



---



# THE TYPES OF PRODUCTS WE ARE LOOKING FOR



House of Sploots is **not intended to become another generic pet store filled with hundreds of random products**.



Every product needs to fit the brand.



Products should ideally be:



- Useful

- Well designed

- Visually appealing

- Suitable for modern homes

- Comfortable and practical for dogs

- Commercially viable

- Capable of producing healthy retail margins

- Available from reliable suppliers

- Appropriate for Australian customers



Potential categories include:



- Dog beds

- Dog sofas

- Elevated pet beds

- Pet furniture

- Feeding products

- Bowls

- Feeding stations

- Collars

- Leads

- Harnesses

- Travel products

- Dog blankets

- Pet storage

- Home protection products

- Dog-friendly homewares

- Selected cat products where appropriate

- Lifestyle products for dog owners



Having a good eye for products, interiors and design is important.



I am **not** looking for someone who searches “dog products”, selects twenty random Alibaba listings and considers the job completed.



---



# SUPPLIER RESEARCH



When evaluating products and suppliers, you may need to investigate:



- Product cost

- MOQ

- Sample cost

- Dropshipping availability

- Whether MOQ 1 is available

- Custom branding

- Private labelling

- Custom manufacturing

- Packaging

- Custom packaging costs

- Supplier location

- Stock location

- Shipping costs to Australia

- Production times

- Processing times

- Delivery estimates

- Tracking

- Stock availability

- Supplier reviews

- Supplier order history

- Supplier reliability

- Alibaba Trade Assurance where applicable

- Product materials

- Product specifications

- Available colours

- Available sizes

- Supplier images

- Supplier videos

- Whether supplier branding can be removed

- Return policies

- Replacement policies

- Damaged-product procedures



You may also communicate directly with suppliers to obtain missing information.



Strong written English is therefore essential.



---



# PRODUCT PROFITABILITY & COMMERCIAL RESEARCH



I do not just want attractive products.



Products need to make commercial sense.



You may help maintain product sourcing spreadsheets containing information such as:



- Product

- Supplier

- Supplier location

- Product cost

- Shipping cost

- Estimated landed cost

- Suggested retail price

- Estimated gross margin

- Competitor pricing

- MOQ

- Processing time

- Delivery time

- Dropshipping availability

- Branding options

- Stock location

- Supplier rating

- Risks

- Concerns

- Notes

- Recommended next action



For example:



If a product looks fantastic but costs almost as much to ship to Australia as the product itself, I want that identified.



If one supplier has a cheaper unit price but another supplier gives us a much better landed cost, I want you to recognise that.



Your job is not simply to find products.



Your job is to help identify **good products from good suppliers that make commercial sense for the business**.



---



# COMPETITOR & MARKET RESEARCH



You may also research:



- Australian pet brands

- International pet brands

- Successful e-commerce stores

- Successful Shopify stores

- Trending dog products

- Emerging pet-home trends

- Competitor pricing

- Product positioning

- Customer reviews

- Common customer complaints

- Gaps in competitors' ranges

- Social media trends

- Potential new product categories

- Products gaining traction overseas that may suit the Australian market



The objective is not to copy competitors.



It is to understand the market and identify opportunities.



---



# 3. SOCIAL MEDIA & CONTENT MANAGEMENT



You will also help establish and manage the House of Sploots social media presence.



Platforms may include:



- Instagram

- TikTok

-

- Pinterest

- YouTube Shorts where appropriate



You should ideally be comfortable using:



- Canva

- CapCut or similar video-editing software

- Meta Business Suite

- Social media scheduling tools

- Shopify

- ChatGPT and other AI tools when used appropriately



---



# SOCIAL MEDIA RESPONSIBILITIES



Tasks may include:



- Creating content calendars

- Planning weekly content

- Creating Instagram posts

- Creating Reels

- Creating TikToks

- Editing short-form videos

- Creating Stories

- Creating carousels

- Creating Pinterest content

- Creating simple graphics

- Adding captions to videos

- Adding on-screen text

- Researching appropriate trending audio

- Writing captions

- Writing hooks

- Writing calls to action

- Scheduling content

- Uploading content

- Using relevant hashtags

- Using appropriate social and search keywords

- Monitoring comments

- Assisting with customer DMs where authorised

- Monitoring competitor content

- Researching content trends

- Repurposing content across multiple platforms

- Maintaining a content calendar

- Tracking basic social media performance



I will be able to provide product information, photographs and footage, including footage involving Nyla.



You should be comfortable taking existing material and turning it into polished, engaging content.



---



# HOUSE OF SPLOOTS BRAND STYLE



House of Sploots should feel:



- Warm

- Playful

- Stylish

- Modern

- Confident

- Human

- Useful

- Authentic

- Relatable



We love dogs.



That does **not** mean every sentence needs to contain a dog pun.



The brand should combine an elevated homewares aesthetic with the reality of actually living with dogs.



Visual consistency and attention to detail are important.



---



# DAILY WORK REPORTING



Clear reporting is a requirement of this role.



At the end of every working session, I expect a short written update explaining:



- What you completed

- What you reviewed

- Any problems you identified

- Any supplier responses received

- Anything you are waiting on

- Anything that needs my approval

- Anything that needs my decision

- What you plan to work on during your next session



I want **outcome-based reporting**, rather than vague activity reporting.



For example, instead of:



**“Worked on Shopify today.”**



I would prefer:



**“Reviewed 12 Shopify products, corrected collection assignments on five products, identified three products with missing Australian shipping information, contacted those suppliers for clarification and updated four product descriptions to match the House of Sploots brand.”**



I want to be able to clearly see what has been achieved during the hours worked.



---



# WEEKLY REPORTING



At the end of each week, I would also like a concise weekly report covering:



- Everything completed

- Products added or updated

- Supplier communication

- Product sourcing completed

- Social media work completed

- Issues discovered

- Tasks still outstanding

- Tasks waiting on suppliers or third parties

- Tasks waiting on me

- Recommendations

- Opportunities you identified

- Priorities for the following week



I want to understand exactly where the business stands without having to chase you for information.



---



# INITIATIVE & PROBLEM SOLVING



I do not expect you to know everything.



I **do expect you to investigate problems**.



If you discover an issue:



1. Identify the problem.

2. Determine whether you can safely resolve it.

3. Research the available options.

4. Explain what you found.

5. Recommend what you think should happen next.



One of the most valuable things you can say to me is:



**“I noticed this wasn't working properly, so I investigated it and this is what I found.”**



That is much more valuable than:



**“I didn't do it because I wasn't sure.”**



You should never make major commercial, financial or supplier decisions without my approval.



However, routine operational work should not require permission at every step.



---



# ACCURACY IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



House of Sploots will be selling physical products to customers.



You must never invent, guess or assume:



- Product materials

- Dimensions

- Product specifications

- Stock availability

- Delivery times

- Shipping costs

- Certifications

- Guarantees

- Product benefits

- Supplier claims

- Return policies



If information is unclear, investigate it.



If you cannot verify it, flag it.



I would rather delay publishing a product than publish incorrect information.



---



# TASK MANAGEMENT & ORGANISATION



You should be comfortable working from shared spreadsheets, task lists or project-management systems.



Tasks may be organised by:



- Priority

- Status

- Supplier

- Product category

- In progress

- Waiting on supplier

- Waiting on approval

- Completed

- Next action



Your work should be organised well enough that I can quickly see what is happening without needing to ask you for a separate explanation.



---



# QUALITY OVER SPEED



I am not looking for someone who rushes through as many tasks as possible.



I would rather have:



**10 products researched, categorised and presented correctly**



than:



**50 products uploaded badly that then need to be fixed.**



Attention to detail is extremely important.



---



# SECURITY & CONFIDENTIALITY



You may receive access to business systems including Shopify, supplier platforms, social media accounts and shared business documents.



You must:



- Keep business information confidential

- Never share account access with another person

- Never share login details

- Use secure passwords

- Use two-factor authentication where available

- Protect customer information

- Never unnecessarily download or retain customer information

- Immediately report suspicious account activity

- Never provide another contractor with access without my permission



You must never, without prior approval:



- Purchase products

- Place supplier orders

- Subscribe to paid software

- Start paid advertising

- Commit to paid supplier services

- Spend business funds



---



# WORKING HOURS



This position will initially be approximately:



## 10 HOURS PER WEEK



I prefer these hours to be spread across several days rather than completed in one large block.



For example:



### 4 days per week × approximately 2.5 hours per day



There is flexibility around the exact days and hours.



The reason I prefer the hours to be spread throughout the week is because Shopify issues, supplier communication, social media and product sourcing often require follow-up.



I am based in Brisbane, Australia, so some overlap with Australian business hours would be helpful.



---



# POTENTIAL FOR THE ROLE TO GROW



This position begins at approximately **10 hours per week**.



It is **not currently a full-time position**.



However, there is genuine potential for the position to grow.



If I am happy with your:



- Quality of work

- Reliability

- Communication

- Initiative

- Accuracy

- Productivity

- Ability to work independently



then the hours may increase as House of Sploots develops and grows.



I am also an entrepreneur developing and operating other business interests, so there may eventually be opportunities to assist with additional businesses.



I do not want to promise something that does not yet exist.



However, if I find someone excellent, I would much rather increase that person's hours, responsibilities and involvement than continually recruit new people.



---



# WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



You may be a great fit if you are:



- Proactive

- Highly organised

- Detail-oriented

- Resourceful

- Commercially minded

- Creative

- Reliable

- Comfortable learning new platforms

- Confident with Shopify

- Good at independent research

- A strong problem solver

- Comfortable communicating directly with a founder

- Able to follow brand guidelines

- Good at managing multiple tasks

- Comfortable documenting your work

- Reliable with deadlines

- Comfortable taking responsibility for your work



I particularly value people who notice things that I may not have noticed myself.



---



# REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Please apply only if you have genuine hands-on experience in several of the following areas:



- Shopify

- E-commerce

- Product merchandising

- Shopify collections

- Shopify navigation

- Shopify apps

- Product sourcing

- Supplier research

- Alibaba

- Syncee or similar supplier platforms

- Dropshipping

- Google Sheets or Excel

- Canva

- Social media management

- Instagram

- TikTok

-

- Short-form video editing

- E-commerce research



### Strong Shopify experience is essential.



This position is not suitable for someone whose only Shopify experience comes from watching tutorials or completing an online course.



---



# BONUS SKILLS



These skills are not essential but would be highly valued:



- Australian e-commerce experience

- Pet industry experience

- Homewares or interiors experience

- Shopify theme editing

- Basic HTML/CSS

- Shopify SEO

-
 marketing

- Klaviyo

- Shopify

- Pinterest marketing

- Meta Business Suite

- Meta Ads

- Google Merchant Centre

- Google Analytics

- Google Search Console

- Customer service

- Supplier negotiation

- Private-label sourcing

- Alibaba manufacturer sourcing

- Graphic design

- CapCut

- AI tools

- Workflow automation



---



# COMPENSATION



Please include your **expected hourly rate in USD** when applying.



I am interested in finding the right person rather than simply finding the cheapest person.



Someone who works efficiently, thinks independently and produces accurate work is considerably more valuable to me than someone who requires constant supervision or whose work needs to be corrected.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



Please read the instructions below carefully.



Applications that clearly have not read the job advertisement may not be considered.



To show me you have read the entire posting, begin your application with:



# SPLOOT READY



Then answer the following questions:



1. What is your name and where are you based?

2. How many hours per week are you currently available?

3. What is your expected hourly rate in USD?

4. How many years have you worked with Shopify?

5. Please provide examples of Shopify stores you have worked on.

6. What exactly were you responsible for on those stores?

7. What experience do you have sourcing products?

8. What experience do you have using Alibaba?

9. Have you used Syncee or another supplier integration platform?

10. Tell me about one product you previously sourced and how you evaluated the supplier.

11. Please provide examples of social media accounts or content you have worked on.

12. Please provide examples of Canva, Reels, TikTok or short-form video work.

13. Have you previously worked with Australian, New Zealand, UK, US or other international clients?

14. What computer and internet setup do you use?

15. What other skills do you believe would make you valuable to this business?



### I would also particularly like you to answer this question:



**Tell me about a time you discovered a problem that your client or employer had not noticed. What was the problem, what did you do about it and what was the result?**



I am very interested in your answer to this question.



---



# SHORT VIDEO APPLICATION



Please also provide a short:



## 2–4 MINUTE LOOM VIDEO



Please include:



- A brief introduction

- Your Shopify experience

- An e-commerce project you have worked on

- Your responsibilities on that project

- Your product sourcing experience

- An example of social media or content work

- Why you think you would be a good fit for this role



Please do not spend hours creating or editing your video.



It does not need to look professionally produced.



I am interested in how you communicate and in understanding your actual experience.



If you cannot show previous client work because of confidentiality, that is completely fine. Explain the work you completed instead.



---



# SHORTLISTED APPLICANTS



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a **small paid practical assessment**.



The assessment may involve something such as:



- Researching one potential House of Sploots product

- Comparing several suppliers

- Reviewing product and shipping costs

- Explaining which supplier you would choose and why

- Structuring a sample Shopify product listing

- Explaining how you would categorise the product

- Creating a simple social media concept



### This will be a paid assessment.



I am not looking to obtain free work from applicants.



I simply want to understand how you:



- Research

- Organise information

- Identify problems

- Think commercially

- Make recommendations

- Communicate your reasoning



---



# WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



After working with you, I should be able to see that:



- The Shopify store is becoming increasingly organised

- Products are correctly categorised

- Product information is accurate

- Supplier information is properly documented

- Shipping information is clear

- Product sourcing decisions make commercial sense

- Social media content is being consistently prepared

- Problems are identified early

- Tasks are followed through

- I know what has been completed

- I know what still needs to happen

- I spend less time fixing operational problems



Ultimately:



## I AM LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO MAKES THE BUSINESS EASIER TO RUN.



---



# FINAL NOTE



House of Sploots is currently in its **pre-launch stage**.



The Shopify website is being built and developed now, and the business has **not yet launched to customers**.



This means the person joining me will be coming in at an important stage and will have the opportunity to help build and organise the store properly before launch — including product sourcing, supplier research, shipping information, product organisation, merchandising, social media and launch preparation.



I am looking for someone who combines:



**E-commerce knowledge + organisation + creativity + initiative.**



There is genuine potential for the role and the number of hours to grow if we work well together and I am happy with the quality of the work.



If you are genuinely good with Shopify, enjoy researching products and suppliers, understand social media and enjoy helping build an e-commerce business from **pre-launch onwards**, I would love to hear from you.



Remember to begin your application with:



# SPLOOT READY

title: Senior AI Systems Consultant | Dashboards, Automation & AI Agents
description:
**Company:** JJT Consulting Group  

**Location:** Remote  

**Engagement:** Project based, hired task by task  

**Compensation:** Quoted and agreed upon for each project



JJT Consulting Group is a growing business funding and education company. We’re looking for a **senior AI consultant who can build working systems**, improve our dashboards, and help us operate with more clarity and accountability.



This is for someone who has already built and deployed solutions for real businesses. We do not need an AI enthusiast, a prompt writer, or someone learning these tools on our time.



## What we need help with



Our projects may include:



- Improving dashboards so leadership can see sales, client progress, funding production, team activity, and bottlenecks in one place.

- Connecting data across GoHighLevel, spreadsheets, forms, and other tools we use.

- Building automations that reduce manual handoffs and missed follow-ups.

- Creating AI agents to support internal workflows, research, reporting, quality checks, and team execution.

- Documenting processes, ownership, and alerts so work does not depend on the founder checking everything.

- Auditing an existing workflow, identifying what is broken, and implementing the fix.



We expect you to recommend the right solution for each task, build it, test it with real scenarios, document it, and hand it off so our team can use it.



## Required expertise



You must have **professional, hands-on experience** with AI tools and agent workflows, including **Codex, Claude, and Hermes**. You should also be capable of working with APIs, automations, dashboards, and the systems needed to connect them.



Experience with GoHighLevel, n8n, reporting tools, and business operations is highly valuable. You must understand how to handle client data responsibly and design systems with appropriate access controls.



## The level we’re looking for



You should be able to take a business problem, ask the right questions, map the workflow, and deliver a working result. You can explain tradeoffs clearly, catch edge cases, and tell us when an AI agent is the wrong solution.



We’re looking for someone who has done this before and can show it. **If your experience is limited to experimenting with AI tools or creating basic chatbots, this role is not a fit. Please do not waste your time or ours.**



## How this engagement works



We will assign a defined project with a scope, deliverables, timeline, and agreed price. Strong execution can lead to additional projects. This is **not a guaranteed full-time position or a standing monthly retainer**.



Each completed project must include:



- A working, tested deliverable.

- Clear documentation of how it works and how the team uses it.

- A walkthrough or handoff.

- Any limitations, dependencies, and maintenance requirements.



## How to apply



Please send:



1. Your résumé or professional profile, including your relevant employment and consulting history.

2. **Two or three systems you personally built and deployed.** For each, explain the business problem, your exact role, the tools used, what you delivered, and the measurable outcome. Screenshots or walkthrough videos are welcome; remove confidential client information.

3. Your hands-on experience with **Codex, Claude, and Hermes**. Be specific about what you built with each tool.

4. Your experience with GoHighLevel, n8n, APIs, and dashboard or reporting tools.

5. Your availability, time zone, and how you typically price a clearly scoped project.



**Screening question:** A funding company has data spread across GoHighLevel and spreadsheets. The founder wants a dashboard showing leads, signed clients, clients waiting on documents, applications, approvals, funded amounts, and stalled files. How would you validate the data, design the dashboard, automate updates, and alert the right person when a file stalls?



We will review your actual work and your answer before scheduling an interview. Shortlisted applicants may be offered a **paid, limited-scope first project** to demonstrate how they work.

title: B2B Cold Caller, Prospecting, Lead / Sales Generation, Appointment Setter, VA
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly motivated B2B Sales & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant to help generate new business opportunities for a U.S.-based telecommunications Account Executive which is T-Mobile



The ideal candidate is comfortable making high-volume outbound calls, researching businesses, speaking with owners and decision-makers, handling objections, qualifying prospects, and booking appointments.



This is a performance-driven sales position. Your success will be measured by the number and quality of qualified appointments you generate.



Key Responsibilities



1. Lead Generation



* Research and identify small and mid-sized businesses.

* Build targeted prospect lists using Google Maps, Google Search, business directories, LinkedIn, and other sources.

* Identify the business owner, manager, office manager, or person responsible for wireless/telecommunications.

* Find business phone numbers and available contact information.

* Prioritize businesses that are likely to have multiple employees, company phones, tablets, hotspots, or fleet vehicles.



2. Cold Calling



* Make outbound B2B calls to business prospects.

* Introduce our telecommunications solutions professionally.

* Quickly identify whether the business is a potential fit.

* Ask discovery questions about their current wireless provider, number of lines, monthly spending, and pain points.

* Handle common objections professionally.

* Generate interest without being overly aggressive.



3. Appointment Setting



* Book qualified appointments directly on the Account Executive’s calendar.

* Confirm the appointment with the prospect.

* Send follow-up messages when appropriate.

* Maintain accurate appointment notes.

* Make sure appointments meet the agreed qualification criteria.



4. Follow-Up



* Follow up with prospects who aren’t ready to speak immediately.

* Re-contact previous leads.

* Maintain a structured follow-up schedule.

* Track conversations and outcomes in the CRM/spreadsheet.



5. Sales Intelligence

The VA should identify opportunities such as:



* Businesses with 5+ employees

* Multiple business phone lines

* Companies with fleet vehicles

* Construction companies

* HVAC companies

* Plumbing companies

* Electrical contractors

* Landscaping companies

* Pest control companies

* Roofing companies

* Delivery/courier companies

* Property management companies

* Medical/dental offices

* Professional-service businesses

* Salons/barbershops

* Other businesses likely to have multiple wireless users



Ideal Candidate



We’re looking for someone who:



* Has B2B cold-calling experience

* Has appointment-setting experience

* Has strong spoken English

* Sounds confident and professional on the phone

* Is comfortable making 50–100+ outbound calls per day

* Can handle rejection without becoming discouraged

* Understands basic sales psychology

* Can identify decision-makers

* Can overcome common objections

* Is organized and detail-oriented

* Can work independently

* Has reliable internet and a quiet workspace

* Is comfortable using Google Sheets/Excel, CRM systems, and communication tools

* Is highly motivated by performance and results



Performance Expectations



Daily targets:



* 50–100+ outbound calls

* 20+ meaningful conversations when possible

* 10–20+ newly researched prospects

* Consistent follow-up on previous prospects

* Accurate CRM/spreadsheet updates



Primary KPI:

Qualified appointments booked



Quality is more important than simply booking appointments. Appointments should ideally be with a business owner or decision-maker who has a legitimate need for business wireless services.



Qualification Questions



The VA should learn to determine:



1. Who is currently providing your business wireless service?

2. Approximately how many business lines do you have?

3. Are those lines company-owned or employee-owned?

4. Roughly how much does the business spend on wireless each month?

5. Are you currently under contract?

6. Are you experiencing any issues with your current provider?

7. Who makes the final decision regarding your wireless service?

8. When would you be open to reviewing another option?



The goal is not to hard-sell on the first call. The goal is to determine whether there is an opportunity and get the qualified prospect onto the Account Executive’s calendar.

title: Part-Time Appointment Setter — US Small Business Outreach (Night Shift, 9 hrs/wk to start)
description:
Part-Time Appointment Setter — US Small Business Outreach (Night Shift, 9 hrs/wk to start)



I run a payments company in New Orleans, Louisiana (USA) and need a sharp, reliable appointment setter to make friendly courtesy calls to small business owners.



THE WORK: You'll call warm and provided lists (no lead hunting - I supply everything) to rebook appointments and schedule short visits for our free equipment placement program. You are never selling anything on the phone and never asking for payment info - you announce, capture a few quick facts, and set the appointment. Full word-for-word scripts, a training document, our phone app, and a tracking sheet are all provided.



SCHEDULE: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday - 8:00 to 11:00 AM US Central Time (this is NIGHT SHIFT in the Philippines — please only apply if you genuinely want long-term night work). 9 hours/week to start, growing to 15–20+ hours and more responsibility for the right person.



PAY: $6/hour base PLUS $20 bonus for every appointment that holds (the person shows up). Top setters will earn $450–$550/month on just 9 hours a week. Paid weekly, every Friday, via Wise. First two weeks are paid calibration - we tune together.



REQUIREMENTS: Excellent conversational English (you'll be calling Louisiana business owners), a quiet workspace, a good headset, stable internet, and appointment-setting / telemarketing / BPO experience.



HOW TO APPLY (follow exactly or you will not be considered):



Hey, I just had a moment before my next call. Is the person who handles the merchant account available? Kevin’s a local doing his neighborhood route Thursday. We don’t send him unannounced, so we’re calling ahead. He’ll stop by for five minutes to show the new free placement program for businesses that qualify for free point of sale equipment, I can’t attach a voice recording from here. Read that version in a relaxed, conversational tone — like a neighbor calling, not a pitch. Aim for about 20–25 seconds.







One or two sentences on your appointment-setting experience.



Applications without PELICAN and a voice recording are deleted. The best voice wins a paid two-hour live test this week, then the job.

title: Operations Manager - (Pathway to Director of Operations)
description:
About the Company 

Nelson Finance Life LLC (NFL) is a U.S.-based financial consulting and government compliance firm focused on helping businesses navigate complex regulations while building long-term financial stability. We operate in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and are building systems to scale across compliance consulting, financial services, and government contracting.



About the Role

title: SEO MANAGER (ORGANIC SEO ONLY – LONG-TERM ROLE)
description:
IMPORTANT: Please read this carefully before applying. Generic applications will be ignored.



We are an Australian facilities management company with a growing digital footprint across multiple service industries. We are looking for a highly capable Organic SEO Manager to take full ownership of our SEO strategy and execution. This is not a junior role, not a “content poster” role, and not a shortcut or black-hat SEO role.



If you rely on AI alone, spam backlinks, or vague SEO theory, this role is not for you.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

You will own organic SEO end-to-end, including strategy, execution, tracking, and results.



• Full SEO audits and ongoing optimisation of existing websites

• Keyword research focused on commercial intent and local/service SEO

• Content optimisation of existing blogs and service pages (we already have large content libraries)

• Creating SEO briefs and optimisation instructions (not just writing content)

• Technical SEO basics: site structure, indexing, crawl issues, Core Web Vitals awareness

• Backlink strategy focused on quality, relevance, and safety (no PBNs, no spam)

• Monitoring performance via Google Search Console and Analytics

• Clear monthly reporting showing what moved, why it moved, and what’s next



You are expected to think, not just execute tasks.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

• Not social media

• Not paid ads

• Not AI-generated bulk content without human SEO logic

• Not micromanaged



We care about rankings, traffic quality, and conversions, not vanity metrics.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

Only apply if you meet ALL of the following:



• 3+ years hands-on organic SEO experience

• Proven ranking results for competitive or service-based keywords

• Strong keyword research skills (you must understand search intent, not just volume)

• On-page SEO expertise (titles, headings, internal linking, content optimisation)

• Comfortable using Google Search Console and Google Analytics

• Experience with WordPress or similar CMS

• Ability to explain SEO decisions clearly in English



If you cannot explain why something works, you are not ready for this role.



BONUS (NOT REQUIRED BUT HIGHLY VALUED)

• Local SEO experience (service areas, location pages, Google Business Profiles)

• Experience optimising large existing content libraries

• Basic technical SEO understanding (indexing, crawl paths, site health)

• Experience working with Australian or international clients



WORK SETUP & EXPECTATIONS

• Remote role (Philippines-based)

• Full-time, long-term position

• Results-focused environment

• Direct communication with the company owner

• Clear expectations, no micromanagement



SALARY

Competitive and based on proven ability, not promises. Performance reviews based on measurable SEO outcomes.



HOW TO APPLY (THIS IS IMPORTANT)

To be considered, your application MUST include the following:



A short explanation (in your own words) of how you approach SEO for a service-based business



One example of a website you helped rank, including what you did and what improved



The word “ORGANIC” at the top of your application so we know you read this



Applications that do not follow these instructions will be ignored.



We are looking for someone who wants stability, ownership, and long-term growth, not someone looking for a short-term gig.



If you’re confident in your SEO skills and want to be judged on results, we want to hear from you.

title: Real Estate Virtual Assistant | Cold Calling, Lead Follow-Up & Admin
description:
I’m a real estate agent and team lead in Singapore. I’m looking for a virtual assistant to help me call leads, follow up with clients and handle paperwork for property transactions. This is a long-term role that will move to full-time after an initial paid training period if it is a good fit for both of us.



Phone calls are a key part of the job. You’ll call people who have enquired about a property, follow up with past leads and make cold calls when needed. You’ll ask about their plans, help arrange appointments and keep clear notes so no follow-up is missed.



You’ll also help with daily admin and transaction work. I’ll provide templates and checklists, and train you on my process for Singapore property transactions.



Your work will include:



• Calling leads, following up and booking appointments

• Sending WhatsApp or
 follow-ups using agreed wording

• Recording call outcomes and the next step for each lead

• Preparing transaction documents from templates and checking details carefully

• Updating transaction checklists and keeping track of deadlines

• Organising client files in Google Drive

• Helping with scheduling, property listing admin, research and simple Canva tasks



I’m looking for someone who:



• Has experience making cold calls or other outbound sales calls

• Speaks clear English and is confident and natural on the phone

• Listens well and can handle questions or objections calmly

• Is careful with paperwork and keeps client information private

• Is comfortable using Microsoft Word, Google Drive, Google Docs and Google Sheets

• Can learn new processes and follow through without constant reminders

• Has reliable internet and a quiet place to make calls



Canva experience is helpful, but you can learn it on the job. You do not need experience with Singapore property transactions, as I’ll train you on my templates and process.



Hours and pay



We’ll start with a paid training period of 20–25 hours per week for two to four weeks. The plan is to move to 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, during agreed Singapore business hours if it is a good fit for both of us. Please apply only if you’ll be available for full-time hours after the training period.



The full-time salary range is PHP 30,000–40,000 per month, depending on experience. Pay during the initial training period will be based on the agreed number of hours.



To apply, please send:



1. Your CV

2. A 60 to 90 second voice recording introducing yourself

3. A short description of your calling experience, including who you called and whether you booked appointments

4. Your experience with Word, Google Drive, Docs, Sheets and Canva

5. Your available working hours in Singapore time and expected full-time monthly salary in PHP



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a Zoom interview, a live practice call and a short document task using sample information.

title: HR Recruiter
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced **Senior Recruiter** to lead and execute full-cycle and strategic recruitment initiatives across a variety of roles within the organization. This role demands not only excellent sourcing and assessment skills, but also a deep understanding of strategic talent acquisition practices—from workforce planning to pipeline development.



The Senior Recruiter will partner closely with department heads and senior leadership to build recruitment strategies that align with business goals and support organizational growth.



**Prior recruitment experience within the Property Management or Real Estate industry is strongly required**, particularly in hiring for roles such as Property Managers, HOA/Community Association Managers, Maintenance Coordinators, Leasing professionals, Finance staff, and other property management support positions.



### Key Responsibilities



* Lead and oversee the strategic recruitment process, including proactive talent sourcing, candidate engagement, and workforce planning for both immediate and future hiring needs.

* Manage full-cycle recruitment for **Property Management, HOA/Condominium Association, Maintenance, Leasing, Finance, Operations, and other related positions**.

* Serve as a consultative partner to department heads and executives, offering insights and solutions to hiring challenges and building long-term recruitment plans.

* Conduct job intake meetings with hiring managers to define the ideal candidate profile, assess role criticality, and align on recruitment strategies.

* Design and implement targeted sourcing campaigns on platforms such as LinkedIn, OnlineJobs.ph, Indeed, and other niche job boards.

* Build strong talent pipelines for recurring and hard-to-fill Property Management positions.

* Conduct behavioral and structured interviews and assess candidates for technical skills, experience, communication, and culture fit.

* Evaluate candidates' knowledge of Property Management operations, systems, processes, and industry-specific responsibilities when applicable.

* Review, update, and optimize job descriptions in alignment with market trends, operational needs, and company branding.

* Administer hiring assessments and analyze candidate performance against role requirements.

* Monitor and report recruitment metrics, including time-to-fill, source effectiveness, candidate conversion rates, offer acceptance rates, and hiring quality.

* Mentor and support junior recruiters and recruitment assistants when needed.

* Continuously explore and introduce new tools, sourcing methods, recruitment technologies, and channels to improve recruitment effectiveness and employer branding.



### Qualifications



* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Behavioral Science, Business Administration, or a related field.

* At least **3–5 years of proven experience in strategic and full-cycle recruitment**, preferably within a remote or international work environment.

* **Proven recruitment experience within the Property Management or Real Estate industry is required.**

* Experience recruiting for positions such as **Property Managers, HOA/Community Association Managers, Maintenance Coordinators, Leasing professionals, Property Management Assistants, Operations staff, and related real estate support roles** is highly preferred.

* Strong understanding of Property Management roles, responsibilities, terminology, and candidate profiles.

* Strong background in sourcing executive, specialist, technical, and volume positions across multiple departments.

* Demonstrated expertise in using ATS platforms such as **BambooHR** and sourcing tools such as **LinkedIn Recruiter, OnlineJobs.ph, and Indeed**.

* Proficient in Google Workspace, including Drive, Sheets, and Docs, as well as digital collaboration tools.

* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence and work closely with senior stakeholders and hiring managers.

* High degree of initiative and autonomy, with the ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.

* Analytical mindset with the ability to use recruitment data and metrics to improve hiring decisions and processes.

* Strong sense of discretion and ability to handle sensitive candidate and hiring information with confidentiality.

title: HOA Manager
description:
The HOA Property Manager is responsible for the day?to?day operations, governance support, vendor oversight, and owner/resident experience across an assigned portfolio of homeowner associations. This role requires strong analytical ability, impeccable attention to detail, and exceptional written and verbal communication skills. The manager serves as the primary liaison among the Board of Directors, unit owners, residents, vendors, and internal teams (Maintenance and Finance), ensuring that association operations comply with governing documents, applicable laws, and company standards while meeting service-level and financial targets.



Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like):



Accurate, timely Board packets and meeting facilitation with clear minutes and action logs

Portfolio-level adherence to budgets, assessments, and reserve funding plans in partnership with Finance HOA

Proactive maintenance planning and on-time completion of preventive and corrective work with Maintenance HOA

High owner/resident satisfaction, timely resolution of requests, and transparent communications

Clean annual audits, renewed insurance policies, and documented compliance with statutes and governing documents

Up-to-date task/project management in Asana and on-time delivery of recurring HOA cycles and filings



Key Responsibilities:

1) Board & Governance Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for Board members; prepare agendas, Board packets, and management reports for regular and special meetings.

Interpret and apply governing documents (CC&Rs, bylaws, rules) and relevant state statutes in daily operations; coordinate with counsel when required.

Facilitate annual meetings, elections, and owner notices in accordance with legal and governing document requirements.

2) Owner & Resident Relations

Maintain responsive, professional communication with trustees/Board, unit owners, and residents via email, phone, and portal.

Issue timely association-wide notices (policy changes, maintenance schedules, community events, compliance reminders).

Manage and resolve escalations, complaints, architectural review requests (ARC), violations, and hearings within established SLAs.

3) Financial Coordination & Reporting 

Support budget development, reserve study implementation, and monthly variance commentary; review financials for accuracy.

Monitor assessment billing, collections, payment plans, and delinquency follow-up in alignment with collection policies.

Review and approve invoices, code expenses to budgets, and validate vendor work completion prior to payment.

4) Maintenance, Projects & Vendor Management (with Maintenance HOA)

Translate Board priorities into annual maintenance calendars; schedule and track preventive maintenance and inspections.

Open, monitor, and close work orders; ensure scope, SLA, and quality standards are met; maintain accurate asset records.

Bid, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts (landscaping, janitorial, security, pools, roofing, elevators, etc.); perform periodic vendor reviews.

Coordinate capital improvement projects (RFPs, proposals, schedules, owner notifications, punch lists, closeout documents).

5) Information Management & Systems

Keep all HOA Asana projects/boards current with daily updates, dependencies, and follow-ups; maintain recurring tasks and automations.

Process resale and lender questionnaire packages accurately and within service timelines; maintain fee schedules.

Maintain organized digital records (governing docs, minutes, contracts, insurance, warranties, architectural files) in the association’s repository.

6) Team Leadership & Development

Train and onboard new APMs/PMs on processes, systems (Asana, accounting/portal), compliance, and customer service standards.

Promote a collaborative, service-oriented culture aligned with company values; escalate staffing/resource needs to the Unit Head.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

On-time completion rate for recurring HOA tasks and compliance filings

Work-order first-response and average time-to-close (by priority)

Delinquency rate and collections effectiveness; percent of assessments collected

Budget adherence (OPEX/CapEx) and variance accuracy; invoice cycle time

Owner/resident satisfaction score; complaint resolution time

Board satisfaction score (post-meeting surveys) and action-item closure rate

Qualifications:

3+ years of HOA/condo association management or related property management experience

Demonstrated proficiency with task/project management tools (Asana) and owner portals; strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

Exceptional communication (written and verbal), meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management

Strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills; high attention to detail

Working knowledge of governing documents, meeting procedures, collections, elections, and common HOA statutes

Maintain accurate ledgers for rent, fees, expenses, and reserves per property.

Reconcile accounts regularly and ensure completeness and accuracy.



 2. Tenant Accounts & Rent Management (Reports to Asst FM) 

Monitor tenant accounts and process rent collections.

Apply payments accurately and handle late payments or delinquencies.

Serve as the first point of contact for tenant financial inquiries.



3. Vendor & Expense Management (Reports to Asst FM) 

Review and approve property-related invoices for Asst FM review.

Track recurring and one-time property expenses.

Ensure timely payment of vendors and compliance with budgets.



4. Reporting (Reports to Asst FM, with FM oversight) 

Prepare property-specific financial statements (Income, Expenses, Cash Flow, Budget vs. Actual).

Submit reports to Asst FM for consolidation and landlord presentation.

Escalate unusual financial activity to Asst FM, who may involve the FM.



5. Cash Flow Management (Reports to Asst FM, with FM oversight)

Monitor rental cash flow to ensure operating expenses and obligations are covered.

Flag any cash shortages or funding concerns to the FM.

Coordinate landlord distributions with FM approval.





6. Compliance & Documentation (Reports to FM) 

Ensure all financial activities comply with company policy, lease agreements, and regulatory requirements.

Maintain organized records for audits, inspections, and landlord review.

Report compliance concerns directly to FM.



 7. Coordination & Escalation (Reports to FM) 

Collaborate with property managers, maintenance, and other departments for smooth operations.

Escalate complex or cross-departmental financial issues directly to FM.

Support FM in ensuring timely financial decision-making across teams.

Qualifications:

1-2 years of General Accounting experience

Experience with Microsoft Excel, including the ability to understand and manipulate basic spreadsheets

Proficient Accounting and computer skills with the ability to quickly learn new programs

Effective communication skills, with the ability to clearly and concisely express ideas both verbally and in writing

Ability to display absolute discretion and confidentiality regarding sensitive information

Ability to take initiative to identify, prioritize and implement all elements required for the team to fulfill responsibilities

Ability to work well under pressure and effectively handle multiple, concurrent demands and appropriately prioritize responsibilities

Real Estate experience a plus

Quickbooks experience a plus



































































Key Interview Questions – Finance Assistant / Bookholder

???? Experience & Background

Can you describe the most complex reconciliation you’ve handled? What errors did you find, and how did you resolve them?





Have you ever managed accounts for multiple properties or clients at the same time? How did you stay organized?





What financial systems and tools have you used (QuickBooks, Excel, property management software)? Which one challenged you the most and why?







???? Property Financial Oversight

If you discover that a property’s ledger shows a surplus but the landlord insists there is a deficit, how would you verify the accuracy and explain your findings?





How would you handle a situation where rental income has been misallocated between two properties?





Tell me about a time when you found inconsistencies in property-related financial data. What steps did you take?







???? Tenant Accounts & Rent Management

A tenant claims they already paid rent, but there’s no record in the system. How do you investigate and resolve this?





How do you track and follow up on delinquent accounts without damaging the tenant relationship?





What process do you follow to ensure tenant payment entries are accurate and timely?







???? Vendor & Expense Management

If two invoices come in for the same service but with different amounts, how would you determine which one to process?





What steps do you take to ensure recurring expenses don’t exceed the approved budget?





Have you ever caught an error or overcharge from a vendor? How did you handle it?







???? Reporting & Cash Flow Management

How do you make sure your monthly reports are both accurate and ready on time, especially when you are managing multiple deadlines?





If you identify a cash flow shortfall for a property, what immediate actions would you take before escalating it to the Finance Manager?





What steps do you take to ensure accuracy in budget vs. actual reporting?







???? Compliance & Documentation

How do you make sure financial activities comply with lease agreements and company policies?





If an auditor asks for supporting documentation and you discover missing records, what would be your approach?





Tell me about a time you had to handle sensitive or confidential financial information. How did you protect it?







???? Coordination & Escalation

A property manager pushes you to approve an expense that doesn’t follow policy. What would you do?





How do you balance communication between landlords, tenants, and internal teams when dealing with financial disputes?





Tell me about a time you escalated a financial issue to leadership. What was the outcome?







???? Tools & Technical Skills

Walk me through how you would set up a spreadsheet in Excel to track rent payments for 50+ tenants.





How do you avoid errors when multiple tea
mbers are updating the same QuickBooks or Excel file?





Have you ever suggested or implemented a change to improve financial workflows? What was the impact?







???? Problem-Solving & Judgment

Imagine you discover that monthly reconciliations were skipped for two months. How would you catch up and ensure no errors were missed?





You’re under pressure to close books, but you notice a suspicious transaction. Do you escalate immediately or finish closing first? Why?





What’s the biggest financial mistake you’ve ever made, and how did you correct it?







???? Commitment & Fit

This role requires handling multiple properties/accounts at once. How do you manage time and prioritize when everything feels urgent?





How do you stay calm and accurate when deadlines overlap and you’re under pressure?





What motivates you more: accuracy, deadlines, or recognition? Why?

title: Part-Time YouTube Video Editor — Educational & Finance Videos
description:
Hiring: Part-Time YouTube Video Editor — Educational & Finance Videos



Remote contractor needed for ongoing weekly work. We use doodle animation and visual storytelling to make educational and finance topics easy to watch.



Weekly workload: 



Every week you must finish:



1. One 8–10 minute YouTube video

2. Three related Shorts



If we need more that week, we may add a second package: One extra long video and Three extra Shorts



Both packages, if assigned, must still be finished that same week. Pay will be adjusted for the extra package.

Tools:



 - Intra Doodle for doodle / animated scenes

 -  CapCut for assembly, captions, pacing, music, sound, and Shorts

 -  ElevenLabs and HeyGen AI for voice and avatar assets we provide



A team member can train you on Intra Doodle, and there are also many YouTube tutorials. We will share sample videos so you can match our style.



Responsibilities



- Edit from our scripts, storyboards, voiceovers, and brand materials

- Build clear scenes with animation, images, charts, and diagrams

- Match visuals to the voiceover and keep pacing tight

- Create Shorts with strong hooks that work on their own

- Deliver final videos plus editable project files

- Revise from written feedback until the video meets our standard





Schedule and pay:



- Need some overlap between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time for messages

- Pay can be a fixed weekly rate or hourly

- Each assigned package must be finished within that week so publishing stays on schedule

- Typical turnaround after script and voiceover are delivered: long video in 2–3 days; 3 Shorts in 1–2 days



Requirements:



- Experience editing long-form YouTube videos and Shorts, ideally educational or finance content

- Strong CapCut skills; Intra Doodle experience is a plus

- Willingness to learn Intra Doodle quickly if it is new

- Someone who enjoys editing and can make a strong video without extra hours

- Careful with on-screen numbers and text

- Responsive, professional, and open to feedback



How to apply:

 to 



Subject: Video Editor Application — [Your Name]

Please include:



1. Résumé or a short summary of relevant experience

2. 2–3 samples (at least one long video and one Short), and which parts you personally edited

3. Intra Doodle and CapCut experience. If Intra Doodle is new, how you would learn it and how long that should take

4. Your rate: fixed weekly price or hourly rate for one 8–10 minute video + three Shorts, including revisions to standard. 

5. Estimated production time and turnaround once you know our style

6. Weekly availability, ET overlap between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m., and earliest start date

7. A self-intro video under 2 minutes



Selection process:



Shortlisted candidates will complete a 30-second unpaid CapCut sample on a topic we provide. The sample is for evaluation only and will not be published or used commercially without a separate paid agreement.



We’re looking for a long-term editor who likes the work, communicates clearly, and delivers on time.

title: After-Hours & Weekend Phone Customer Service Rep for a US Pool Company (4 Texas Offices)
description:
IMPORTANT: Do not apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Applications sent through the site will not be reviewed.
 your application to 
 "How to Apply" below.



Type of Work: Part-time

Hours per Week: About 25

Wage: $4–5 per hour, based on experience (paid weekly)



About Us



CK Pools is a pool service company in Texas, USA. We clean and repair residential and commercial pools out of four offices: Dallas, Houston, San Antonio, and Corpus Christi. We serve about 1,100 customers. We need a friendly, reliable person to answer calls for all four offices when they're closed.



Schedule



US Central Time:



Monday to Friday: 4:30 PM to 7:30 PM

Saturday: 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM

Sunday: 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM



Manila Time (until November 1):



Tuesday to Saturday: 5:30 AM to 8:30 AM

Saturday night: 9:00 PM to 3:00 AM

Sunday night: 11:00 PM to 3:00 AM



After November 1, when the US time changes, Manila times move one hour later. Hours may be reduced from November to March, when the pool season is slow.



What You'll Do



Answer calls for all four of our Texas offices, in a warm and professional way

Figure out which office each caller belongs to and route their request to the right team

Help new callers sign up for weekly pool service and explain our service plans

Book repair visits and diagnostic appointments

Take clear messages and log them in our system for the office team

Answer common questions using our scripts and FAQ guide

Spot urgent issues and send them to the right manager

Send a short summary of your calls at the end of each shift



What We're Looking For



Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent

At least 1 year of call center or phone customer service experience with US customers

Calm and patient with upset callers

Good at taking accurate notes while on the phone

Comfortable keeping track of several locations, each with its own team and service area

Quick to learn new software. We use Dialpad and Pool Brain, and we'll train you on both

Reliable. When you're scheduled, customers are counting on you to pick up



Requirements



Fast, stable internet, plus a backup connection (mobile data or a second provider)

Backup power (UPS or generator)

A quiet, private work area with no background noise

A computer and a noise-canceling headset

Willing to work the weekend overnight shift (Manila time)



Nice to Have



Experience in home services (pool, HVAC, plumbing, pest control, and so on)

Experience booking appointments or dispatching



How to Apply



Send the following:



Your resume

A short note about your phone customer service experience

A 2-minute voice recording. Pretend a customer is calling CK Pools because their pool turned green, and show how you'd answer.

A screenshot of your internet speed test (speedtest.net)



Start your application with the words "Clear Water" so we know you read the whole post. Applications without the voice recording will not be reviewed.

title: Part-Time Social Media Manager & Content Creator | CapCut, Canva & Reels
description:
Company: Sunlake Cards  

Website: 
  

Location: Remote 

Employment type: Part-time  

Hours: 10 hours per week, approximately two hours per day, Monday–Friday  

Schedule: Flexible working hours  

Monthly base: $220–$300 USD, depending on experience and portfolio  

Performance bonus: Up to $75 USD per month after the initial measurement period  

Payment schedule: Twice monthly  

Paid practical assessment: $20 USD for selected finalists  



ABOUT SUNLAKE CARDS

Sunlake Cards helps people celebrate birthdays, special occasions, and everyday connections through digital greeting cards and invitations. Our cards are currently free and have no watermark.



We are looking for a creative, organized social media professional to manage our Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube content.



Our main goal is to attract people in the United States and Canada who will visit 
 and use it to send cards. We also want to grow a relevant audience and make our social pages attractive, useful, and consistent.



YOUR ROLE

You will take ownership of content ideas, planning, creation, and performance improvement. You should enjoy suggesting new approaches and explaining why they could work.



You will have creative freedom within our brand guidelines. Content and profile changes require approval before publication.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Develop content ideas around birthdays, celebrations, holidays, invitations, and thoughtful reasons to send a card.

- Plan and create two original content pieces per weekday: at least one short-form video, plus a static post, carousel, or second video.

- Use real Sunlake cards and website recordings to create engaging product demonstrations and promotional content.

- Write compelling opening hooks, clear captions, and relevant calls to action.

- Adapt and publish approved videos across Instagram Reels,
 Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

- Adapt other content formats for the platforms where they fit.

- Maintain an organized content calendar and submit content in batches for approval.

- Improve profile presentation through consistent covers, bios, highlights, and pinned content.

- Monitor comments and messages within agreed working hours, answer routine questions using approved information, and escalate other inquiries.

- Review performance weekly and recommend practical content experiments.

- Keep final exports and editable project files organized and accessible.



WORKLOAD AND WORKING STYLE

Our starting target is 10 original content pieces per week, including five videos. Cross-platform versions are adaptations of those pieces, not separate original concepts.



We expect efficient batching, reusable templates, and straightforward production using existing Sunlake assets. During the paid assessment and first month, we will confirm what fits within the agreed hours.



All planning, editing, revisions, scheduling, community management, and reporting count toward paid working time. Any increase in hours or scope will be agreed together.



You may request additional brand materials or recordings. Appearing on camera is welcome but not required. This role focuses on organic social content and short-form video.



REQUIRED SKILLS

- Demonstrated experience creating content for business social media accounts.

- A portfolio showing short-form video editing and static or carousel design.

- Proficiency with CapCut, Edits, or comparable video-editing software.

- Proficiency with Canva or a comparable design tool.

- Strong written English and an understanding of content for US and Canadian audiences.

- Good judgment about hooks, storytelling, pacing, captions, and calls to action.

- A clean, polished visual style that feels warm, thoughtful, and modern.

- Experience planning, scheduling, and adapting content across social platforms.

- Ability to interpret basic performance data and turn findings into new ideas.

- Reliable communication, organization, and openness to feedback.



HELPFUL ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE

- Driving website visits or product usage through organic social content.

- Microsoft Clarity, tracked campaign links, or website conversion reporting.

- Content for consumer products, celebrations, lifestyle brands, or digital services.

- Creating authentic product demonstrations from screen recordings.



BRAND AND CONTENT STANDARDS

Use authentic Sunlake cards and accurate product screens. Promotional claims must reflect approved product information.



Use original or appropriately licensed assets and music. We value relevant audience growth and authentic engagement. Purchased followers, artificial engagement, and misleading claims are not acceptable.



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED

We will review:

- Consistent delivery of accurate, high-quality content.

- Website visits from relevant US and Canadian audiences.

- Completed card sends attributable to tracked organic social traffic.

- Relevant follower growth and useful engagement.

- Learning from results and improving future content.



The first 30 days will establish a working rhythm and measurement baseline. Performance bonus targets will be agreed in writing before the bonus period begins. Base compensation is separate from bonuses.



COMPENSATION

- Fixed monthly base of $220–$300 USD, depending on demonstrated skills and experience, for the agreed 10-hour weekly schedule.

- Up to $75 USD in monthly performance bonuses after the initial measurement period.

- Base paid twice monthly through an agreed payment method, such as Wise.

- Required paid software or assets must be approved in advance and will be provided or reimbursed.

- Opportunity to expand hours and compensation as the working relationship develops.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject:

Sunlake Creator — [Your Name]



Please include:

1. A short introduction and a summary of your relevant experience.

2. Links to three short-form videos and two static posts or carousels you created. Explain your contribution to each.

3. One example of a result you helped achieve. Identify whether it was organic or supported by paid promotion. If results are unavailable, explain how you evaluated the work.

4. The editing, design, and scheduling tools you use.

5. Your weekly availability and earliest start date.

6. Your expected monthly base within the advertised range.

7. A brief explanation of how you would organize the proposed workload within 10 hours per week.



Please share existing work only. No custom content is required with your initial application.



HIRING PROCESS

Application and portfolio review → short interview → paid practical assessment for selected finalists → paid first month.



Finalists will receive the same brief for a $20 USD assessment lasting no more than three hours. The assignment will include one short video, one companion static post, and a brief explanation of the creative approach.



Every finalist who completes the agreed assessment will be paid, regardless of the hiring decision. Permission and usage terms will be agreed before any assessment content is published.



We are looking for a dependable, creative person interested in building a long-term relationship with Sunlake Cards.

title: Transaction Coordinator/ Property Management / Customer Support
description:
_________________________________________________________________
