_________________________________________________________________



LISTING & TRANSACTION COORDINATOR (Remote, Full-Time)



Schedule: [Night shift, PH time – see Technical Requirements]



We're hiring a highly organized, systems-minded Real Estate Transaction Coordinator.



This role is for someone who lives in the details, obsesses over contract deadlines, and can run a complex transaction pipeline without dropping a single ball. You won't just be checking boxes. You'll spot gaps in the contract-to-close process, automate repetitive work, and make sure every client and partner gets a seamless, "magic moment" closing.



Please read the entire listing carefully. There's an instruction inside that you'll need for your application.



ABOUT THE TEAM



Want to work in a fast-paced, rewarding, start-up environment?

Looking for real growth and performance bonus opportunities?

Have a growth mindset, value relationships, and care about results?



Then we might be a fit.



Why partner with us? We're not your ordinary client: youtu.be/n_MyyhWrXNs

What's it like to work with us? Hear from our team: youtu.be/smT-w2M_TcQ



OUR CORE VALUES



DELIGHT THE CLIENT

We exceed expectations by anticipating needs, delivering outstanding service, and creating "magic moments" where every client feels seen and heard.



MASTER YOUR CRAFT

We commit to continuous learning, share our expertise openly, and tackle every challenge with precision and a deep sense of duty.



FOLLOW THROUGH, ALWAYS

When we say something will happen, it does. We own every task, nothing falls through the cracks, and when mistakes happen, we learn and improve right away.



We're building an exceptional place to work, with strong systems and high standards, not just managing tasks for a real estate business.



ABOUT YOU



You think in priorities, timelines, and dependencies.

You enjoy turning a ratified purchase contract or listing agreement into a structured project plan with clear deadlines.

You're the one who catches a missing signature or a math error on a Closing Disclosure before anyone else does.

You take pride in building clean systems, documenting SOPs, and keeping a team aligned without constant supervision.

You communicate fast and keep projects moving.



If you're a high-level operator who wants to own the "engine room" of a high-volume real estate team, keep reading.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Transaction & Listing Management



Contract-to-close ownership: Manage every part of buyer and seller transactions, from signed purchase agreement to closing, using SkySlope and GoHighLevel.

Pre-listing and pre-offer prep: Run full pre-listing and pre-offer checklists so every property and offer is set up to succeed.

Property research briefs: Build detailed briefs covering property mechanicals and a verified timeline of major home system replacements.

Market research: Prepare comps and pricing data to support senior brokers' pricing strategy.

Offer packets: Draft offer packets with accurate signature blocks and routing, then submit them to the broker for review.

Compliance: Submit all required documents to the office broker and keep every file 100% compliant, with no missing disclosures, under the direction of the responsible broker.

Closing logistics: Coordinate with attorneys, lenders, title officers, and brokers. Collect CD/ALTA statements and check them against the commission agreement for broker review.



Project & Operations Management



Communication prep: Draft
 templates that help senior brokers communicate quickly with clients and key partners.

System building: Spot workflow inefficiencies and design and implement improvements or automations that cut manual work.

SOP documentation: Document workflows as step-by-step guides so processes are repeatable and scalable.

KPI reporting: Keep the Deal Tracker (Google Sheet) and GHL opportunity values current so leadership always has accurate data.

Connective tissue: Be the bridge between leadership, agents, and clients so nothing gets dropped.



REQUIREMENTS



Experience & Capability



Extensive experience in real estate transaction coordination, transaction management, or high-level operations support

Comfortable managing 20+ active files at once, each with different deadlines

BPO customer service background (highly preferred)

Experience automating workflows, or a solid understanding of how to design them (highly preferred)

Working knowledge of SkySlope and GoHighLevel (strongly preferred, not required)

Confident using AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini to work faster



Work Style & Standards



Extremely detail-oriented: You find the needle in the haystack every time.

Near-native English: Excellent written and spoken communication.

Proactive ownership: You don't wait to be told something's broken. You see it coming and fix it first.

Speed and urgency: You move with purpose and hit every deadline.



TECHNICAL & SCHEDULE REQUIREMENTS



Stable, high-speed internet connection (minimum [50] Mbps) plus a backup

Available to respond to messages during core hours of 8:00 AM–8:00 PM EST ([8:00 PM–8:00 AM PH time])

Flexible to work 2–4 hours on weekends when urgent business needs come up [paid/included]



APPLICATION & HIRING PROCESS



STEP 1: APPLICATION

Apply here:

To show you've read the full listing, write "green kangaroo" in the Additional Comments field.



STEP 2: INITIAL INTERVIEW

If your application looks like a strong fit, we'll invite you to a quick 10–15 minute screening call.



STEP 3: CASE INTERVIEW

Candidates who pass screening are invited to a 1-hour case interview. We'll give you a real-world scenario from this role and watch how you work through it. The goal is to see your problem-solving, technical logic, and how you handle practical situations in real time, not just hear about your past experience.



STEP 4: REFERENCE CHECK

This is the final step before an offer. Finalists must provide at least one former employer or team lead reference and one character reference. We verify both before extending an offer.



STEP 5: 90-DAY PAID TRIAL

If you accept an offer, you'll start with a 90-day paid trial so we can both confirm the fit, for the role and for our core values. We'll give you the training, onboarding, and support you need to succeed. You'll be expected to master our SkySlope/GHL workflow, meet every transaction deadline, and start documenting and improving our internal systems. A successful trial leads to a permanent spot on the team.

title: Part-Time YouTube Virtual Assistant — Channel Management & Optimization
description:
Hiring: Part-Time YouTube Virtual Assistant — Channel Management & Optimization



We’re looking for an experienced YouTube Virtual Assistant to manage the daily operations of our educational and finance channels. This is an ongoing remote position working directly with our team.



Our ideal candidate is **responsive, organized, reliable, efficient, and a fast learner**. You should communicate promptly, meet deadlines consistently, keep tasks and files organized, and learn new tools and processes quickly.



You must have hands-on experience with **YouTube management tools and video optimization** and be comfortable handling a wide range of tasks with minimal supervision.



**Weekly Workload**



- One 8–10-minute YouTube video and three related Shorts per channel.

- Work alongside our video editor and other team members to coordinate production, prepare uploads, and manage channel operations.

- **If you are looking for additional hours, there may be an opportunity to manage two YouTube channels**, depending on performance and availability.



**Responsibilities**



- Research video topics, competitors, keywords, and audience interests.

- Suggest compelling video ideas, hooks, titles, and thumbnail concepts.

- Help prepare and refine outlines, scripts, and calls to action.

- Coordinate with team members, maintain the content calendar, and track deadlines.

- Review videos for spelling, captions, audio quality, visual consistency, and alignment with the approved script.

- Create or coordinate thumbnails and make basic edits when needed.

- Upload and optimize long videos and Shorts, including titles, descriptions, tags, captions, chapters, playlists, cards, and end screens.

- Schedule approved content and verify that uploads publish correctly.

- Review and optimize older videos and organize channel playlists.

- Monitor comments, prepare replies, and flag questions requiring our attention.

- Track views, click-through rates, audience retention, watch time, and subscriber growth.

- Provide biweekly performance reports with specific recommendations.

- Keep project files organized and provide regular progress updates.

- Handle other YouTube-related administrative and content support tasks as needed.



**Requirements**



- Previous experience managing or supporting YouTube channels.

- Experience optimizing videos for search visibility, clicks, and audience retention.

- Proficiency with YouTube Studio and experience with tools such as vidIQ, TubeBuddy, or similar platforms.

- Familiarity with Canva, Google Drive, and ChatGPT or similar AI tools.

- Strong written English and attention to detail.

- Ability to check AI-generated content and use reliable sources, especially for educational and finance topics.

- Prompt communication, a positive work attitude, and consistent follow-through.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

- Ability to work efficiently within an agreed weekly budget and learn new tools quickly.

- Reliable internet access and advance communication about potential delays.

This role is for someone who lives in the details, obsesses over contract deadlines, and can run a complex transaction pipeline without dropping a single ball. You won't just be checking boxes. ABOUT THE TEAM



Want to work in a fast-paced, rewarding, start-up environment?

Looking for real growth and performance bonus opportunities?

Then we might be a fit.



Why partner with us? We're not your ordinary client: youtu.be/n_MyyhWrXNs

What's it like to work with us? Hear from our team: youtu.be/smT-w2M_TcQ



OUR CORE VALUES



DELIGHT THE CLIENT

We exceed expectations by anticipating needs, delivering outstanding service, and creating "magic moments" where every client feels seen and heard.



MASTER YOUR CRAFT

We commit to continuous learning, share our expertise openly, and tackle every challenge with precision and a deep sense of duty.



FOLLOW THROUGH, ALWAYS

When we say something will happen, it does. We own every task, nothing falls through the cracks, and when mistakes happen, we learn and improve right away.



We're building an exceptional place to work, with strong systems and high standards, not just managing tasks for a real estate business.



ABOUT YOU



You think in priorities, timelines, and dependencies.

You enjoy turning a ratified purchase contract or listing agreement into a structured project plan with clear deadlines.

You're the one who catches a missing signature or a math error on a Closing Disclosure before anyone else does.

You take pride in building clean systems, documenting SOPs, and keeping a team aligned without constant supervision.

You communicate fast and keep projects moving.



If you're a high-level operator who wants to own the "engine room" of a high-volume real estate team, keep reading.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Transaction & Listing Management



Contract-to-close ownership: Manage every part of buyer and seller transactions, from signed purchase agreement to closing, using SkySlope and GoHighLevel.

Pre-listing and pre-offer prep: Run full pre-listing and pre-offer checklists so every property and offer is set up to succeed.

Property research briefs: Build detailed briefs covering property mechanicals and a verified timeline of major home system replacements.

Market research: Prepare comps and pricing data to support senior brokers' pricing strategy.

Offer packets: Draft offer packets with accurate signature blocks and routing, then submit them to the broker for review.

Compliance: Submit all required documents to the office broker and keep every file 100% compliant, with no missing disclosures, under the direction of the responsible broker.

Closing logistics: Coordinate with attorneys, lenders, title officers, and brokers. Collect CD/ALTA statements and check them against the commission agreement for broker review.



Project & Operations Management



Communication prep: Draft
 templates that help senior brokers communicate quickly with clients and key partners.

System building: Spot workflow inefficiencies and design and implement improvements or automations that cut manual work.

SOP documentation: Document workflows as step-by-step guides so processes are repeatable and scalable.

KPI reporting: Keep the Deal Tracker (Google Sheet) and GHL opportunity values current so leadership always has accurate data.

Connective tissue: Be the bridge between leadership, agents, and clients so nothing gets dropped.



REQUIREMENTS



Experience & Capability



Extensive experience in real estate transaction coordination, transaction management, or high-level operations support

Comfortable managing 20+ active files at once, each with different deadlines

BPO customer service background (highly preferred)

Experience automating workflows, or a solid understanding of how to design them (highly preferred)

Working knowledge of SkySlope and GoHighLevel (strongly preferred, not required)

Confident using AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini to work faster



Work Style & Standards



Extremely detail-oriented: You find the needle in the haystack every time.

Near-native English: Excellent written and spoken communication.

Proactive ownership: You don't wait to be told something's broken. You see it coming and fix it first.

Speed and urgency: You move with purpose and hit every deadline.



TECHNICAL & SCHEDULE REQUIREMENTS



Stable, high-speed internet connection (minimum [50] Mbps) plus a backup

Available to respond to messages during core hours of 8:00 AM–8:00 PM EST ([8:00 PM–8:00 AM PH time])

Flexible to work 2–4 hours on weekends when urgent business needs come up [paid/included]



APPLICATION & HIRING PROCESS



STEP 1: APPLICATION

Apply here:

To show you've read the full listing, write "green kangaroo" in the Additional Comments field.



STEP 2: INITIAL INTERVIEW

If your application looks like a strong fit, we'll invite you to a quick 10–15 minute screening call.



STEP 3: CASE INTERVIEW

Candidates who pass screening are invited to a 1-hour case interview. We'll give you a real-world scenario from this role and watch how you work through it. The goal is to see your problem-solving, technical logic, and how you handle practical situations in real time, not just hear about your past experience.



STEP 4: REFERENCE CHECK

This is the final step before an offer. Finalists must provide at least one former employer or team lead reference and one character reference. We verify both before extending an offer.



STEP 5: 90-DAY PAID TRIAL

If you accept an offer, you'll start with a 90-day paid trial so we can both confirm the fit, for the role and for our core values. We'll give you the training, onboarding, and support you need to succeed. You'll be expected to master our SkySlope/GHL workflow, meet every transaction deadline, and start documenting and improving our internal systems. A successful trial leads to a permanent spot on the team.

title: Dispatcher — National Fleet Network
description:
# Remote Dispatcher + Outbound Sales



**National Fleet Network** is hiring remote dispatchers to support our growing U.S. commercial fleet service network.



This is a combined **dispatch + outbound calling** position. You will help coordinate roadside service calls while also contacting fleets and service technicians to help grow our network.



## Compensation



**$6–$10 USD per hour base pay + commission**



Your starting base rate will depend on experience, communication skills, reliability, and overall fit.



You will also have the opportunity to earn additional commission through outbound calling and business development activities.



There is room to grow with the company as National Fleet Network expands.



## What You’ll Do



### Dispatching

- Answer and manage incoming roadside service requests

- Dispatch diesel technicians and service providers

- Communicate with drivers, fleet managers, technicians, and repair shops

- Track active jobs from dispatch through completion

- Provide updates when technicians are delayed or situations change

- Document service details accurately in our system

- Follow up with technicians and customers as needed

- Assist with general operations and administrative work during slower periods



### Outbound Calling

- Cold call trucking fleets and fleet managers

- Introduce National Fleet Network and our roadside service network

- Generate interest from potential fleet customers

- Contact diesel technicians, mobile mechanics, and service providers

- Recruit qualified technicians into the NFN service network

- Follow up with interested prospects

- Maintain accurate notes and follow-up information

- Work toward outreach and conversion goals



**Commission is tied to successful outbound results, including new fleet customers and technician recruitment.**



## What We’re Looking For



- Strong spoken English

- Clear and professional phone presence

- Comfortable making outbound cold calls

- Strong written English

- Reliable internet connection

- Quiet work environment

- Dependable and punctual

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Comfortable handling urgent situations

- Able to communicate confidently with U.S. customers

- Comfortable learning new software and processes

- Able to follow scripts while still sounding natural



Experience in any of the following is a plus:



- Dispatching

- Trucking

- Logistics

- Roadside assistance

- Diesel repair

- Towing

- BPO / call center work

- Appointment setting

- Cold calling

- Lead generation

- Sales



Automotive or diesel knowledge is helpful but **not required**.



## Schedule



This is a remote position supporting customers in the United States.



We are hiring for multiple shifts, including daytime, nighttime, and weekend coverage.



Applicants must be able to work their assigned schedule consistently.



## Important



This position requires **real phone work**.



You must be comfortable:



- Answering inbound calls

- Calling drivers and technicians

- Cold calling businesses

- Speaking with fleet owners and managers

- Following up with prospects

- Handling occasional difficult or urgent conversations



If you do not like talking on the phone or making outbound calls, this position will not be a good fit.



## How to Apply



Please submit your application along with a short **voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your relevant experience**.



Applications without a voice recording may not be considered.



**National Fleet Network**  

Keeping fleets moving.

title: IT Administrator
description:
The IT Manager is responsible for ensuring our technology infrastructure, tools, and processes support a growing team efficiently and securely. This is a founding IT role - the company has some processes in place but much of the IT function is underdeveloped, and this person will be expected to both operate hands-on from day one and build the systems and standards that scale with us.



A core initial focus is identity and access management: managing the full user lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding, and ensuring access to tools is accurate, timely, and auditable. Alongside this, the role is responsible for identifying gaps in our IT processes and building the policies, documentation, and workflows to close them.



This role reports to the CTO and works closely with HR, Operations, and team leads across the business. The right person is equally comfortable executing day-to-day access tasks and stepping back to design the process around them. They have strong Google Workspace Admin experience, a solid understanding of IAM concepts, and the judgment to prioritise what to build first in an environment where not everything exists yet.



Core Responsibilities

- Review and approve access requests for all new hires. For tools with direct integrations, approval triggers automatic provisioning. For tools without, manually complete the setup inside the tool itself.

- Offboard departing employees same business day — approve removal and manually revoke access in any tools that require it.

- Process access change requests — update a user's permission when their role, responsibilities, or required access level changes.

- Work with managers to create and maintain access templates when new role types are added.

- Run periodic access reviews to confirm the access inventory is accurate and up to date.

- Identify gaps in existing IT processes and build the policies, documentation, and workflows to address them.

- Own IT policy development — covering areas such as device management, acceptable use, data handling, and security standards.

- Be the first point of contact for access requests, access questions, and IT support across the business.

- Keep process documentation current so every access change and IT procedure is repeatable and auditable.

title: Warehouse & Inventory Reconciliation Coordinator
description:
Reports to: Operations Manager

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Warehouse & Inventory Reconciliation Coordinator to support our growing Amazon wholesale operation.

This role will be responsible for tracking inventory throughout the supply chain, identifying discrepancies, communicating with our warehouse and suppliers, and ensuring inventory and financial records remain accurate.

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating issues, reconciling data between systems, and following processes to completion.

This position will begin at approximately 20 hours per week during training and onboarding, with the expectation of transitioning to full-time after successful completion of training.



Working Hours

Training Period

6:00 PM – 10:00 PM Mountain Time

Approximately 4 hours per day, 20 hours per week

Full-Time Schedule

9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Mountain Time

8 hours per day, 40 hours per week

Provides overlap with our warehouse operations team



Primary Responsibilities

Inventory Tracking & Reconciliation

Track inbound shipments from suppliers to warehouse

Use carrier delivery confirmations (UPS, FedEx, regional and LTL carriers) as the official delivery date, and confirm each delivery is checked in by the warehouse within the agreed timeframe

Investigate delayed, missing, or incomplete shipments

Escalate deliveries not checked in within the agreed window, with the carrier proof of delivery attached

Compare supplier shipment confirmations against warehouse receipts

Identify inventory discrepancies and escalate issues as needed

Warehouse Coordination

Communicate daily with warehouse staff via Slack

Follow up on missing inventory, damaged products, and receiving issues

Assist with inventory investigations and exception handling

Evaluate damage reports and photos against Amazon’s New condition standard – a product in damaged retail packaging is damaged even if the item works

Maintain organized records of open issues and resolutions in the shared escalation and holding logs

Supplier Claims & Credits

File supplier claims for shortages, damages, and missing inventory within each supplier’s claim window (often 48–72 hours after delivery)

Maintain a reference of claim windows and documentation requirements by supplier

Request RMAs and supplier credits when appropriate

Track outstanding claims through resolution

Include reconcile in the subject of your
 application

Verify supplier credits are properly issued and received

Inventory & Software Reconciliation

Compare warehouse shipments against software records

Verify inventory movements are accurately reflected in company systems

Identify discrepancies between physical inventory and software data

Assist with ongoing inventory accuracy initiatives

Financial Reconciliation Support

Review discrepancy reports generated by our automated tracking tools (delayed-shipment alerts in ClickUp and Google Sheets trackers)

Compare identified discrepancies against supplier invoices, shipment records, and credit memos

Verify supplier credits and RMAs are ultimately received

Escalate unresolved discrepancies for further review

Audit prep center invoices against the agreed rate card and against receiving and shipment records; request itemized breakdowns when charges change

Monitor carrier adjustment and freight reclass charges on outbound shipments and identify the cause

Amazon Seller Central Support

Maintain Amazon listings, including marking out-of-stock items as non-replenishable, removing listings that will not be replenished, and creating listings to generate MSKUs.

Monitor Account Health and flag issues that need action; assist with negative feedback cases.

Open and follow up on cases for inventory lost or misplaced at Amazon warehouses.

Assist with customer inquiries, brand validation, COGS updates, and document requests as assigned.



Ideal Candidate

Extremely detail-oriented

Strong organizational skills

Comfortable working with spreadsheets and data (Google Sheets); experience with Slack and ClickUp preferred

Investigative mindset; enjoys solving problems

Able to follow processes consistently

Strong written English communication

Comfortable communicating with suppliers and warehouse personnel

Holds a position with evidence when a partner disputes a record – professional and calm, not escalatory

Able to manage multiple open issues simultaneously



Preferred Experience

Inventory management

Supply chain operations

Warehouse coordination

Amazon FBA operations

Data reconciliation

Administrative support

Accounts payable or inventory auditing experience



Success Metrics

Inventory discrepancies identified and resolved

Claims filed within each supplier’s claim window

Supplier credits successfully recovered (credits recovered vs. amount claimed)

Open warehouse issues resolved promptly (age of open escalations)

Accurate reconciliation between inventory systems

Timely communication with suppliers and warehouse personnel

Reduction in unresolved inventory and credit discrepancies



Employee Expectation

Uphold company values and maintain a positive work environment. 

Ensure confidentiality of company information, including leads and supplier details. 

Use the time-tracking software Hubstaff accurately and with integrity. 

Must work 40 hours per week, 160 hours per month. 

Must attend KPI meetings every week.



Compensation

$960 –$1120 USD per month full-time; training hours paid at the equivalent hourly rate

Paid time off accrues at 1-day per month, up to 12 days per year. Unused PTO may accumulate and is paid out at the end of the year.

Paid holidays include Good Friday, All Saints’ Day, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year’s Eve, New Year’s Day, and your birthday.

We promote from within and offer growth opportunities and pay increases based on performance.

To support long-term stability, we maintain reserves equivalent to six months of operating costs.



How to Apply

Send an
 to 
 your resume and why you would be a good fit for this specific role.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid practical exercise: reconciling a set of carrier deliveries against a check-in log and an invoice, and writing up the exceptions.

title: Wanted: A Social Media VA Who Can Make a Book Launch Go Viral
description:
Wanted: A Social Media VA Who Can Make a Book Launch Go Viral



September 25, 2026 Pay: $425/month (about 15 hrs/week, roughly $6 to $7/hr) Start: Immediately. Our book launches at the end of October, and presale content needs to start now. Engagement: This is a paid trial period during our book launch and presale phase. If it's a good fit on both sides, this converts into an ongoing long-term role with increased hours and pay as scope grows.



About the Role



We're launching a new book and need a sharp, creative, reliable social media VA to run day to day content and community engagement during the presale and launch period.



We'll share the specific book, genre, and brand voice during the interview. For now, what matters most is that you know how to run a book launch on social media: build hype, turn reviews into content, and keep momentum going daily.



This is not a "schedule 3 generic posts and walk away" role. We want someone who thinks like a book marketer.



We're hiring fast. We review applications daily and move quickly to interviews. If you meet the bar below, apply now instead of waiting.



Day to Day Responsibilities

Post 2 to 3 times a day across the platforms we assign, with content tailored to each one, not the same copy pasted everywhere

Manage multiple social accounts. The exact platforms will be confirmed during the interview, but may include a mix of
, Instagram, X 
), TikTok, Bluesky, and an author newsletter (Substack or similar)

Set up new accounts or platforms as needed, for example launching a new author newsletter from scratch

Drive presale promotion with ongoing content built specifically to convert followers into pre orders

Repurpose reviews and UGC. When we get a media review, reader review, or influencer post, turn it into multiple pieces of fresh content: quote graphics, short video, carousel posts, Stories, and so on

Create original content: graphics, short form video, and copy suited to each platform's style

Advise on link in bio strategy. Help us d
 whether we need a Linktree (or similar) and what should be in it, then set it up and keep it current

Administer accounts. You'll be given admin level access to manage posting, scheduling, and basic account settings

Who We're Looking For



This role is for an experienced social media VA. Don't apply if you're just starting out, a student, or can't show real client work. We need someone who can hit the ground running with zero training.



2+ years managing social media accounts professionally, for real clients. Not your own personal account, not a school project

A portfolio showing accounts you've actually grown or run, with at least one specific, measurable result you can point to (for example, "grew an author or brand IG from 2K to 15K in 6 months")

Strong eye for content. You can write engaging copy AND put together simple graphics or short video edits (Canva, CapCut, or similar)

Familiarity with BookTok, Bookstagram, or book launch marketing trends is a big plus

Comfortable working independently and proactively. You should be pitching content ideas, not waiting for direction

Reliable weekday availability and good communication in English

Trustworthy with admin level access to client accounts. 2 client references required, with actual contact info we can reach



We verify everything. We check portfolios, live links, and past work claims before responding. If your portfolio doesn't match what you claim in your application, or it turns out to belong to someone else or a company you don't actually work for, your application is disqualified immediately. This isn't a formality. We've caught this before.



Quick Test Task (required to apply, no exceptions)



We get a lot of applicants, and this helps us see how you actually think about content. It should take 15 to 20 minutes:



Imagine we just received this reader review: "I could not put this book down. The world-building alone made me forget I had a job to go to." Show us 3 different ways you'd turn this into content across 3 different platforms (an IG Story, a TikTok concept, an X post). A few lines describing each is fine, no need for finished graphics.



If you skip this, we skip your application. We're not interested in generic capability lists. We want to see how you actually think.



If you're selected for an interview, be ready to do a live version of a similar exercise, on the spot, with a review you haven't seen before. Your written answer should reflect how you'd genuinely respond in real time, not something polished over hours or generated by AI.



How to Apply



Please include all of the following. Incomplete applications will not be considered:



Your portfolio or links to social accounts you've managed, with at least one specific, measurable result

Which social media platforms you have hands on experience managing (Instagram, TikTok,
, X, Bluesky, Substack, etc.). Be specific, not just "social media in general"

Your response to the test task above

2 client references (name and how we can reach them, not "available upon request")

Your available hours per week and time zone

Confirmation you're available at $425/month for this trial period, with the understanding that pay and hours increase if it becomes ongoing



If you've read this closely, work your favorite color into your application somewhere. It doesn't need to be obvious. It just helps us see who reads carefully before applying.



This is a real, paying role with a real deadline, not a portfolio building exercise. If you can't meet the requirements above starting immediately, please don't apply. We won't have time to follow up individually with everyone, so we'll only be responding to complete, qualifying applications.

title: Driver Recruiter
description:
GH Logistics is expanding its recruitment team and is seeking a proactive, confident, and highly independent Driver Recruiter to support our CDL driver recruitment efforts across our trucking operations.



We are looking for someone who is comfortable making high volume outbound calls, engaging driver prospects, qualifying candidates, and maintaining an active recruitment pipeline. This is a phone first and high activity position that requires strong English communication, persistence, organization, and the ability to work independently without constant supervision.



A major focus of this position will be calling CDL driver prospects, following up with potential candidates, and submitting qualified drivers to our Recruitment Lead for further processing.



Role Overview

You will support GH Logistics' driver recruitment efforts by working through daily lead lists, contacting prospective CDL drivers, assessing their qualifications, and maintaining consistent follow-up throughout the recruitment process.



You will be expected to take ownership of assigned leads from initial contact through qualified submission, document recruitment activities accurately, and coordinate with the Recruitment Lead and other departments to move qualified candidates forward.



This is a fast-paced, results-driven role where consistency, call volume, communication, and follow-through are essential. You should be comfortable spending a significant portion of your shift making outbound calls, handling rejection professionally, and maintaining productivity without constant reminders.



You will report directly to our Recruiting Lead, Destiny Conley, and collaborate with the recruitment, onboarding, and fleet operations teams.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Work through assigned daily lead lists and proactively contact prospective CDL drivers through outbound cold calls.

• Qualify driver prospects based on license class, driving experience, availability, interest, and other recruitment requirements.

• Maintain consistent follow up with warm leads, interested drivers, and candidates requiring additional information.

• Manage assigned recruitment leads from initial contact through qualified submission.

• Accurately document all calls, candidate information, statuses, notes, and next steps in the company's CRM.

• Maintain an organized recruitment pipeline and ensure no qualified leads are overlooked.

• Submit qualified driver profiles with complete and accurate information to the Recruiting Lead.

• Coordinate candidate handoffs with the onboarding and fleet operations teams.

• Work toward daily call volume targets, driver connection goals, and weekly qualified submission targets.

• Review inbound leads and pending follow-ups to prioritize daily recruitment activities.

• Provide end-of-day recruitment updates, including calls made, driver connections, qualified submissions, and pipeline status.

• Take ownership of recruitment activities and proactively identify opportunities to improve lead engagement and candidate conversion.



What Success Looks Like

• Consistently completing 60 - 80 outbound calls per day.

• Achieving approximately 15 - 20 driver connections daily.

• Generating 5 - 10 qualified driver submissions per week.

• Maintaining accurate and complete CRM records with no undocumented calls.

• Following up with warm leads within the same day.

• Keeping the recruitment pipeline active, organized, and updated.

• Submitting qualified drivers with complete information for the next stage of recruitment.

• Maintaining consistent communication with the Recruiting Lead.

• Demonstrating persistence, professionalism, and productivity throughout the shift.

• Independently managing assigned leads and recruitment activities without constant supervision.



Performance is reviewed weekly by the Recruiting Lead, with an emphasis on consistent activity, call volume, documentation, and recruitment results.



Who We’re Looking For

• Previous experience recruiting CDL drivers or candidates for the US trucking industry is strongly preferred.

• Confident making high volume outbound calls, qualifying driver prospects, handling objections, and maintaining consistent follow ups.

• Clear, confident, and professional spoken English with the ability to engage effectively with US-based drivers.

• Able to manage leads, track candidate progress, maintain accurate records, and organize recruitment activities efficiently.

• Highly independent, persistent, and accountable, with the ability to meet daily call targets and weekly recruitment goals without constant supervision.

• Reliable, punctual, and organized, with a stable internet connection and a quiet, professional calling environment.

• Typing speed at least 50 words per minute



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.



Schedule & Work Setup

• Current Shift Availability: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time

• Zoom presence (with camera open) required

• Time tracking software used for accountability and performance support



If you are someone who confidently picks up the phone, enjoys connecting with people, can independently work through a recruitment pipeline, and understands the persistence required to recruit CDL drivers, we want to hear from you.

title: Trailer Management Admin
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Hubstaff time tracking during shifts.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who can recognize trailer issues, coordinate repairs, follow up consistently, and ensure equipment returns to service as quickly as possible

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

• Candidates who are unfamiliar with trailer maintenance concerns or are uncomfortable coordinating repairs and operational solutions



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, properly repaired, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, problem-solving, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.

title: Real Estate Inside Sales Agent (ISA) & Virtual Assistant
description:
We are looking for an experienced Real Estate Inside Sales Agent (ISA) & Virtual Assistant to support multiple growing U.S.-based real estate businesses, including residential real estate sales, real estate investing, and property management.



Outbound prospecting and lead follow-up will be the primary focus of this position, but this is a broader real estate role for someone who can also assist with lead generation, PropStream research, CRM management, list building, business development, content creation, and other real estate projects.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our team and grow with our businesses.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Inside Sales & Lead Generation

• Make outbound calls to homeowners, absentee owners, landlords, potential sellers, and other targeted prospects

• Qualify leads by identifying motivation, timeline, property condition, occupancy, and other relevant information

• Handle common objections professionally and naturally

• Schedule qualified appointments and callbacks

• Consistently follow up with warm and long-term leads

• Maintain detailed notes and dispositions in the CRM

• Use a call dialer efficiently and professionally

• Help manage the lead pipeline so opportunities do not fall through the cracks



PropStream & Prospecting

• Use PropStream to research properties and owners

• Build targeted prospecting lists based on criteria we provide

• Work with absentee-owner, high-equity, landlord, vacant-property, and other targeted real estate lists

• Skip trace and organize lead data

• Clean and organize lists before campaigns

• Identify potentially promising properties or owner situations for further review

• Track which lists and campaigns are generating the best conversations and leads



Business Development

• Make outbound calls to organizations, nonprofits, housing providers, community organizations, and other potential partners

• Determine whether organizations have housing or property-management needs

• Identify potential referral and partnership opportunities

• Research organizations and decision makers

• Conduct follow-up outreach and schedule meetings



Real Estate Marketing & Administrative Support

• Assist with real estate content creation and social media

• Help develop basic posts, captions, marketing ideas, and real estate content

• Conduct property, market, and prospect research

• Assist with CRM organization and database management

• Help with miscellaneous projects across our real estate businesses as needed



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS



• Excellent spoken and written English

• Clear, professional, friendly phone presence

• Previous U.S. real estate cold-calling or ISA experience

• PropStream experience strongly preferred

• Experience building and organizing prospecting lists

• CRM experience

• Call dialer experience

• Lead follow-up and appointment-setting experience

• Strong objection-handling skills

• Ability to have a natural conversation rather than simply reading a script

• Strong attention to detail and organization

• Comfortable learning new real estate systems and processes

• Reliable computer, high-speed internet, and quality headset

• Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time hours



Experience with real estate investing, acquisitions, wholesaling, property management, absentee-owner prospecting, landlord prospecting, expired listings, or seller leads is a major plus.



SCHEDULE



Approximately 20 to 40 hours per week to start.



Preferred U.S. Eastern Time 



There is potential for additional hours, responsibilities, and long-term growth based on performance.



COMPENSATION



$5–$7 USD/hour depending on experience and qualifications. Bonus pay based on experience.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words REAL ESTATE ISA so we know you read the entire job posting.



Please include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself

2. Your U.S. real estate experience

3. Your cold-calling / ISA experience

4. Your experience using PropStream — please be specific about what you have done with it

5. Examples of the types of prospecting lists you have built

6. CRMs and dialers you have used

7. Any experience with real estate investing, property management, or real estate sales

8. Any experience creating social media or real estate content

9. Your desired hourly rate

10. Confirmation that you can work the requested U.S. Eastern Time schedule

11. A link to a 60–90 second voice recording



VOICE RECORDING



Briefly introduce yourself and tell us about your real estate experience.



Then role-play the following situation:



You are calling a homeowner regarding a property we may be interested in purchasing. The homeowner says:



“I’m not interested. I get these calls all the time.”



Show us how you would naturally respond.



We are looking for someone who is warm, confident, resourceful, organized, dependable, and comfortable taking initiative. You should be comfortable speaking with people on the phone but also capable of handling the research, CRM, list-building, marketing, and administrative work that supports a successful real estate operation.



If you are looking for a long-term opportunity where you can learn multiple sides of the U.S. real estate industry and grow with the company, we would love to hear from you.

title: Google Business Profile & Listings Specialist for US Church Marketing Agency (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We’re a US-based church marketing company looking for one sharp, detail-obsessed Listings Specialist to keep the Google and online listings for about 180 US churches accurate. This is a long-term, full-time role for someone who gets real satisfaction from getting small details exactly right.



You don’t need local SEO experience. We’ll train you on our process. You need to be organized and careful, and you need to ask when you’re not sure.



When a church’s Christmas Eve service time is wrong on Google, a family shows up to an empty parking lot and may not try again. Your job is to make sure that doesn’t happen at any church we serve.



The basics:



- Full-time and long-term. This is not a short project or a gig.

- Salary: $800 USD per month. Paid in USD, reviewed at 90 days.

- Schedule: flexible. We’ll set your hours together, and at least part of your shift will fall during Philippine daytime. This is not the full graveyard shift most US-hours roles demand. Once we agree on your hours, you’re reliably at your desk during them, every workday.

- 100% remote.



What you’ll own:

- Keeping each church’s Google Business Profile complete and correct: hours, service times, photos, categories, and holiday hours

- Setting up and claiming each church’s listings on 25+ sites, including Apple Maps, Bing, Yelp, and church directories, then logging every one in our tracker

- Checking that each church’s name, address, and phone number match exactly everywhere they appear online, and fixing the ones that don’t

- Scheduling Google posts for every church. AI writes the first draft. You check it against the facts and fix what it got wrong

- Posting replies to Google reviews from each church’s approved templates, and flagging any negative review to our US team the same day

- Sending short, templated
s to church offices to collect photos, verification codes, and holiday service times

- Running our Christmas and Easter updates across every church: holiday hours, event posts, and local community calendar submissions

- Keeping our tracking spreadsheet clean enough that monthly reports build themselves

- You will not make phone calls to clients. This is behind-the-scenes support.



Who we’re looking for:

- This is a faith-based role. You must be a born-again Christian who is passionate about helping churches reach more people and grow. We are especially looking for people who are active leaders in their own local church

- The kind of detail-oriented that notices a phone number formatted two different ways in the same spreadsheet, and can’t leave it alone until it’s fixed

- Organized enough to track 180 churches without letting one slip. You follow a checklist the same way every time, even on the 40th church of the day

- At least one year of admin, data entry, or virtual assistant work for a US business or agency. Google Business Profile or local SEO experience is a plus, not a requirement

- Strong Google Sheets skills. Sorting, filtering, and keeping a big tracker accurate should feel normal to you

- Excellent written English. Posts and review replies go out under a church’s name, and you’re the last check before they do. You catch it when AI invents a service time or a sentence sounds off

- You ask instead of guessing. When two sources disagree about a church’s address or service time, you check with us first

- Rock-solid reliability. You show up every day, on time, and you do not need to be managed



This job is NOT for you if:

- You want creative work all day. This role is mostly data and follow-through

- Doing the same task for dozens of churches in a row sounds boring to you

- You’d rather guess than ask a question

- You’re planning to keep freelance clients on the side. We’re hiring your full attention

- You’re not a believer, or you’d rather not spend every workday on church work. Our whole business is churches. There’s no version of this job that isn’t

- Your internet or power situation is shaky and you have no backup plan. Deadlines don’t wait for brownouts



If any of those describe you, no hard feelings. Save us both the time and skip this one.



About us REACHRIGHT is a US-based church marketing agency, 10 years old, with team members across the US and the Philippines. We already have 11 Filipino teammates. We are an openly Christian company, and everyone on our team shares one mission: helping churches reach more people. We serve pastors and churches every single day.



How to apply:

1. Start your application with the word “Aloha” so we know you actually read this posting.

2. Take the detail test below. List every difference you find between the church’s correct information and the listing we found online. Then tell us which mistake would hurt the church most if nobody fixed it, and why.

3. Tell us about a time you caught a mistake that everyone else missed.

4. Tell us how you are involved in your local church today.

5. Include a resume and a link to a short video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself.



"THE DETAIL TEST"



The church’s correct information:



Grace Harbor Church

1420 Oak Hollow Drive, Suite 200, Round Rock, TX 78664

(512)
Sunday services: 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM

The listing we found online:



Grace Harbour Church

1420 Oak Hollow Dr, Suite 200, Round Rock, TX 78646

(512)
Sunday services: 9:00 AM and 11:30 AM

Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test task before we make an offer.



Applications that do not start with “Aloha,” that skip the detail test, or that have no video will not be reviewed.

title: Elite Acquisitions Closer U.S. Real Estate | Remote | USD Pay
description:
We run a high margin U.S. real estate niche most investors can't touch: partial deeds and title problems. We help families untangle complicated ownership and unlock properties nobody else knows how to close. The deals are unusual, the margins are strong, and the best closer on our team is closing roughly one deal a week.



We're hiring one more sharp closer. The bar is high on purpose.





What This Is





A real sales seat. You research families, get on the phone every day, and build trust with people in hard situations.

This is not a VA role. Not admin. Not "manage a pipeline quietly." You dial, you talk, you move deals.

You'll own leads inside Lofty (our CRM), dial through Dialpad, and pull contacts with SmartSkip.





Your Day





Daily huddle, 10:00 AM ET, cameras on, no exceptions. We review numbers, wins, and blockers together.

75 dials per day minimum, tracked. Your dials, contacts, and conversion are visible to the team every day.

Roughly 40 to 50% research (obituaries, court and tax records, identifying heirs and the real decision maker) and 50 to 60% outreach (calls, texts, voi
s, follow up).

We run a two call close structure. You'll learn it cold.





How We Operate (so you know before you apply)





We track activity daily. If you go dark for a day with no heads up, you won't last here.

We coach hard and expect you to be coachable. B+ players who show up beat A players who don't.

Full training from day one. Clear path to Senior Closer and team lead as you prove out.







What You Need





English at C1/C2 only. Families need to trust your voice on the phone.

5+ years sales experience. Real estate (acquisitions, wholesaling, probate, title) strongly preferred.

Total comfort with daily outbound calling, voi
s, and relentless follow up.

Sharp judgment on who the real decision maker is inside a family.

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, quality headset. Non negotiable.





Schedule





Full time, Monday to Friday

10:00 AM to 7:30 PM Eastern Time





Pay





Base: $1,000 to $1,500 USD per month based on experience

Commission: 10 to 15% depending on deal revenue. Our average deal is over $30,000, so a single close pays well.

Realistic total once ramped: $8,000 per month

Be clear eyed on timing: most reps lock their first deal within 30 days, and commission on that deal pays out around 100 days later once it closes and funds. This niche pays big, but it is not instant money. If you need a paycheck next week, this isn't the seat.







How to Apply



Send a 1 to 2 minute video covering:





Your sales and real estate background

How comfortable you truly are with heavy daily outbound calling

Why you're great at finding and speaking to the right decision maker in a family

Your location and availability

title: Meta Ads Specialist
description:
The role



We're looking for an experienced freelance Meta Ads specialist to set up and manage
 and Instagram campaigns for our upcoming YTT launch. The launch opens with a free three-day webinar series, and most of the ad work will drive registrations for it, followed by enrollment ads to webinar registrants and our existing warm audience. Our in-house team produces all creative and copy, so your focus is campaign setup, tracking, monitoring, and optimization.



Responsibilities



Meta's automation handles much of the ad delivery, and this role requires someone who actively manages it, checks its decisions against actual enrollments, and steps in when it's heading the wrong way. With a two-week launch window, these judgment calls determine whether the launch succeeds.

• Set up and verify Meta Pixel and Conversions API tracking with Kajabi so registrations and purchases are attributed accurately.

• Build and launch campaigns for webinar registration, then enrollment campaigns targeting registrants, social media engagers, and our existing audience.

• Monitor campaigns daily and adjust budgets, audiences, and campaign goals based on performance.

• Track whether ad-sourced registrants attend the webinar and enroll, since Meta will favour the cheapest registrations, and those often come from people who never show up or buy.

• Compare what Ads Manager reports against our own registration, attendance, and enrollment records, and adjust targeting or campaign goals when the ads look strong in Ads Manager but aren't producing enrollments.

• Shift budget from webinar registration campaign to enrollment campaign, according to the launch calendar, and execute promptly.

• Watch for ad fatigue and work with our team to create new content before results decline.

• Navigate Meta's advertising policies for a spiritual offer that uses the word "tantra," and resolve ad rejections quickly.

• Coordinate with our social media strategist and our directors, so paid and organic efforts support each other.



Reporting and communication



• Hold consistent calls and communication, to review performance and answer questions from our directors.

• Provide view access to the ad account and a weekly written report on spend, cost per registration, cost per enrollment, and return on ad spend.

• Document the campaign structure, audiences, and settings so the setup can be repeated for future launches.

• Send daily reports, outlining work, and allotment times of work.

• Deliver a post-launch review covering what worked, what didn't, and recommendations for next time.

• Support in the debrief process.



What we're looking for



• At least [2–3] years managing Meta ad campaigns, with results you can show for webinar funnels, online courses, or coaching programs.

• Experience running launch campaigns with defined open and close dates.

• Comfort working with Meta's Advantage+ automation, along with the judgment to know when to override it.

• Experience diagnosing campaigns where platform metrics and actual sales tell different stories, with examples of how you responded.

• Working knowledge of pixel and Conversions API integration.

• Clear, reliable communication and availability for daily monitoring during the launch.



Engagement details



• Contract type: freelance / contractor

• Term: approximately five to six weeks, from campaign setup through a post-launch review, with the option of ongoing work on future launches

• Estimated hours: 50–60 hours total, heaviest during setup, with daily monitoring through registration and enrollment

• Compensation: $10–12 USD per hour, plus a $50 USD bonus for each enrollment attributed to your ads (a student who purchased through an ad link.)

• Total ad spend: $8000 USD

• Start date: Mid-November

• Location: remote. We're based in Pacific Time and hold calls on weekdays.



To apply



Send resume portfolio and your favorite food.

title: # Experienced 0% APR Business Funding Specialist | Credit Card Stacking
description:
JJT Consulting Group helps U.S. business owners prepare for and access capital. A major part of our work is 0% introductory APR business credit card funding. We review the full credit and business profile, build a funding strategy, sequence applications, and guide clients through the process.



We’re looking for an **experienced Funding Specialist with a verifiable history of working in U.S. business funding**. This is not an entry-level role. You must have personally managed funding files and be able to explain your past responsibilities, decisions, and results in detail.



## What you’ll do



- Review clients’ three-bureau credit reports, existing cards, limits, balances, inquiries, credit age, payment history, and business information.

- Identify funding readiness issues and create a clear plan to address them.

- Build individualized 0% APR business credit card funding strategies based on the client’s profile, banking relationships, eligibility, and current offers.

- Recommend an application sequence and explain the reasoning behind it.

- Guide clients through applications and communicate with banks when follow-up or reconsideration is appropriate.

- Track applications, approvals, limits, denials, inquiries, and next steps accurately in GoHighLevel.

- Keep clients informed, set realistic expectations, and escalate difficult files promptly.

- Verify current bank offers and requirements before advising a client to apply.

- Work closely with our funding manager and client success team to move files forward.



## Required experience



- Prior employment or long-term contract experience with a **U.S. business funding, business credit, or credit card stacking company**.

- Direct, hands-on experience reviewing credit profiles, building funding strategies, sequencing applications, and managing clients through approvals.

- A clear employment history showing **where you worked, when you worked there, your title, who you reported to, and what you were personally responsible for**.

- The ability to discuss specific funding files you handled, including your strategy, obstacles, approvals, and lessons learned—without sharing private client information.

- Strong knowledge of personal credit, business fundability, utilization, comparable limits, inquiries, and application timing.

- Experience reading reports from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.

- The judgment to pause a file when applying would be premature.

- Clear spoken and written English for live client calls and written updates.

- Strong organization and availability during U.S. Eastern business hours.



Experience with GoHighLevel, bank reconsideration, business lines of credit, and other funding products is a plus.



## What success looks like



You build thoughtful, documented funding plans. Clients understand the strategy and their next step. Applications are accurate and properly tracked. You take ownership of denials and stalled files, and you avoid unnecessary applications that could hurt a client’s funding options.



We care about approval quality and sound judgment—not just the number of applications submitted.



## How to apply



Please send the following:



1. **Your résumé with complete relevant employment history.** For each funding-related role, include the company name, dates of employment, job title, manager or department, your day-to-day responsibilities, and the funding products you worked on. Explain any consulting or freelance work separately.

2. **A short video introduction** explaining your previous funding roles, what you personally owned, and the types of client results you helped produce.

3. **Answers to the screening questions below.** Use examples from your own work and remove all client identifying information.



### Screening questions



1. Which U.S. funding or business credit companies have you worked for? When did you work there, what was your title, who did you report to, and why did you leave each role?

2. At each company, which parts of the funding process did **you personally handle**? Which parts were handled by a manager, salesperson, or another team member?

3. Walk us through one client file you personally managed from initial credit review through funding. What was the profile, what strategy did you recommend, and what were the results?

4. What would cause you to tell a client **not to apply yet**, even if their credit score is above 720?

title: Part-Time SEO Specialist for 3 Websites - Proven Results Required
description:
Part-Time SEO Specialist — Manage 3 Websites | Proven Results Required



ABOUT THE ROLE

Yunta is recruiting a hands-on, part-time SEO specialist for a client who needs SEO support across three websites. We are looking for someone who can show real past results, diagnose what is holding a website back, prioritize the highest-impact work, and execute a clear plan.



This is not an entry-level role or a position for someone who only produces audit reports. You should be able to connect SEO work to qualified organic traffic, inquiries, leads, or sales—not just rankings and keyword counts.



Location: Remote, Philippines

Employment type: Part-time

Hours: To be agreed based on your availability and the scope across all three websites. Include your proposed weekly hours in your application.

Compensation: Based on experience and scope. Submit your expected hourly rate AND monthly fee in USD, stating the weekly hours and deliverables covered.

Website URLs, business details, target markets, current performance, and access arrangements will be shared during the hiring process. Please do not assume all three websites have the same needs.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Audit all three websites and establish a baseline using Google Search Console, GA4, and appropriate crawling/research tools.

• Identify technical issues affecting crawling, indexing, site architecture, internal linking, redirects, canonicals, sitemaps, structured data, mobile usability, and page experience.

• Research relevant search terms and search intent, map keywords to pages, and prioritize opportunities based on commercial relevance, competition, and effort.

• Improve titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, page structure, and existing content without keyword stuffing.

• Develop practical content briefs and recommendations that address real customer questions and support business goals. Edit or optimize existing content and coordinate new content with the client or writer as needed.

• Implement SEO changes within your agreed access and skill set. Provide clear instructions to developers for changes requiring development support, then verify the work.

• Evaluate local SEO opportunities where relevant, including Google Business Profile, location pages, and accurate business listings. Local SEO needs will depend on each website's business model.

• Identify legitimate link-earning and authority-building opportunities. No purchased spam links, private blog networks, fake reviews, or other shortcuts that put the websites at risk.

• Track organic search performance and meaningful conversions, clearly separating branded/non-branded traffic and different websites where the data allows.

• Maintain a prioritized task list for each website, allocate part-time hours sensibly, and communicate what is completed, blocked, or waiting on client input.



INITIAL DELIVERABLES

During the first 30 days, adjusted to the agreed hours and available access:

1. A concise baseline and SEO audit for each website, with evidence of the main issues and opportunities.

2. A prioritized 90-day roadmap across all three sites, including quick wins, larger projects, dependencies, and estimated effort.

3. Implementation of agreed high-priority improvements, with a record of changes made.

4. A simple reporting setup and recommendations for any missing conversion tracking.



ONGOING REPORTING

Provide a brief weekly progress update and a monthly report covering work completed, organic traffic and search trends, relevant conversions, key findings, and next priorities. Explain what the numbers mean for the business. We do not expect overnight ranking guarantees; we expect sound judgment, clear execution, and transparent reporting.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

• Demonstrated hands-on SEO success with at least two past websites or campaigns you can discuss in detail.

• Strong technical and on-page SEO fundamentals, keyword research, content optimization, and performance analysis.

• Practical experience with Google Search Console and GA4, plus tools such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush, or equivalent. Explain which tools you use and whether you have access to them.

• Ability to work inside website CMS platforms and coordinate with developers when needed. State the platforms you know best; the client's website platforms are not yet specified.

• Clear professional English, dependable follow-through, and the ability to explain SEO recommendations to a nontechnical client.

• Capacity to manage priorities across three websites within an agreed part-time schedule.



NICE TO HAVE

Experience with U.S.-based businesses, local/service-business SEO, conversion optimization, and managing multiple client websites. These are advantages, not substitutes for documented results.



HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE ANSWER EACH ITEM

Use the subject: SEO Specialist - 3 Websites



1. Introduce yourself briefly, summarize your relevant SEO experience, and link your resume and portfolio.

2. Provide TWO case studies. For each, include:

   • Website URL or an anonymized description if confidentiality prevents sharing it.

   • Your role and exactly what you personally implemented versus work done by a team.

   • Starting metrics, ending metrics, and the dates/timeframe involved.

   • Results such as non-branded organic traffic growth, qualified leads, sales, or relevant ranking improvements, with context.

   • Supporting evidence such as redacted Search Console/GA4 screenshots or reports. Do not share passwords, client personal data, or confidential information without permission.

   • Any factors that may have influenced the results, such as seasonality, a redesign, or increased content production.
